title: Senior Machine Learning Manager, Borrowing
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London/Cardiff/UK Remote | 💰 £138,000 to £176,000 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance + benefits | Hear from the team ✨

About the role

Borrowing is one of Monzo’s most important growth engines. We’ve built strong scale in the UK, and the next phase is even more ambitious: grow in the UK, expand into new customer segments, and build the underwriting capability needed to scale into Europe.

We’re looking for a senior ML leader to help shape that next phase.

You’ll lead a high-calibre team of ML scientists and help define Borrowing’s ML roadmap across UK growth, new customer segments, and EU expansion. You’ll work across underwriting, pricing, limits, and lifecycle decisioning — improving today’s models while helping build the next generation of capability for Monzo.

This role combines near-term commercial impact with long-term strategic advantage:

  • improving performance across our range of products
  • unlocking new data and faster model development
  • helping Monzo build underwriting that scales into new markets
  • shaping how advanced ML and AI can create real value in Borrowing

You’ll partner closely with leaders across Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, Model Validation, Data, and Platform, and influence decisions that shape both business performance and the long-term architecture of credit decisioning at Monzo.

What you’ll own

  • Borrowing ML roadmaps across UK optimisation, new customer segments, and EU expansion
  • Faster model improvement through new data and feature engineering
  • How Monzo uses Open Banking, transaction intelligence, and external data in credit decisioning
  • More portable underwriting capabilities across products, customer segments, and markets
  • Hiring, leading, and developing a high-performing ML team
  • Raising the bar on model quality, governance, tooling, and speed of iteration

What you’ll be working on

Examples of the challenges you could help lead:

  • Improving underwriting models across Loans, Flex, and Overdrafts
  • Expand the data we use in our models
  • Building better feature engineering and model shipping capability
  • Improving transaction intelligence for credit use cases
  • Developing underwriting capabilities for new customer segments and EU markets
  • Shaping Monzo’s approach to advanced ML and AI

Our technology stack

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies, although we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all of them:

  • Google Cloud Platform
  • BigQuery SQL and dbt
  • Python and the PyData stack
  • Google AI Platform
  • AWS
  • Python for ML services
  • Go for backend services
  • AI tooling for productivity
  • Google Workspace including Gemini
  • ChatGPT Enterprise
  • Claude Code

You should apply if

  • You want to shape the next phase of credit decisioning at one of Europe’s most ambitious fintechs
  • You enjoy combining strategic leadership with strong technical judgment
  • You’re excited by the intersection of underwriting, data, product, and platform capability
  • You like building teams as much as building models
  • You care about real customer and business impact

You must have

Credit and machine learning

  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistics, and decisioning systems
  • Deep experience in credit risk and lending
  • Experience building, deploying, and iterating credit models in production
  • Experience pushing the innovation frontiers of the credit industry

Leadership and delivery

  • Experience leading and developing senior ML scientists
  • Strong cross-functional leadership with Product, Credit Strategy, Engineering, and Validation
  • Track record of turning strategy into practical delivery in a regulated environment

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience across more than one market
  • Experience with advanced ML methods and AI on structured financial data

The interview process

  • 30 min Recruiter Call
  • 45 min Initial Call
  • 60 min ML technical interview
  • 60 min People Leadership interview
  • 60 min Product / Credit ML interview

All interviews will be conducted through Google Meet.

What’s in it for you

💰 £138,000 to £176,000 ➕ plus stock options & benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office with a hybrid working pattern, or fully remote within the UK with occasional travel to London.

🏡 We’ll set you up to work from home, including support for remote setups.

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work in a way that lets you do your best work.

📚 Learning budget for books, training courses and conferences

➕ And much more — see our full list of benefits here

#LI-DC2 #LI-Remote

Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Head of Design Technology
description:
Job Title: Head of Design Technology 

Actual Annual Salary: £32,916 - £51,048 (M1 to UPS3) 

TLR Allowance: TLR 2BB (£8,020) 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Full-time, 32.5 hours per week / 1.0 FTE 

Provisional Start Date: asap

Your opportunity to lead, inspire and shape outstanding teaching and learning as Head of Department: 

We are looking for an inspirational and ambitious Head of Department who is passionate about delivering excellent educational experiences and improving outcomes for all students. 

You will use your leadership skills to champion the success and life chances of all children in our trust. Through high expectations, effective use of assessment and progress data, and a commitment to an ambitious and inclusive curriculum, you will support both students and colleagues to achieve their very best. 

As Head of Design Technology, you will lead a team of six colleagues across Design Technology, Food Technology, Photography and Art. 

About you: 

You will be: 

  • a qualified teacher with a degree and QTS, with experience of teaching across Key Stages 3 and 4 and the full ability range. 
  • an excellent classroom practitioner with strong subject knowledge and the ability to deliver consistently high-quality, engaging lessons. 
  • able to lead curriculum development within your subject area, with a strong understanding of effective teaching, learning and assessment. 
  • confident in using assessment and progress data to identify areas for improvement and implement effective interventions. 
  • an inspiring and supportive leader who can motivate colleagues, develop the practice of others and contribute to a high-performing team. 
  • an effective communicator who can build positive relationships with students, colleagues, families and the wider community. 
  • committed to high expectations, inclusion, safeguarding and creating opportunities that enrich students' learning and improve their life chances. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application. 

About Broadoak Academy: 

Broadoak Academy is an ever-growing secondary school located in Weston-super-Mare and is quickly becoming the school of choice for parents in the town. We are very proud to be an Ofsted-rated ‘Good’ school. We have a strong sense of belonging and community, and as such, we work together to offer students a well-balanced, happy and successful education. Our community is assured of Broadoak’s pivotal role in their children’s education, wellbeing and futures. 

Why CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to the Teachers’ Pension Scheme. 
  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support for career development and wellbeing.  
  • Sector-leading professional development entitlement and opportunities. 
  • Collaboration with colleagues across the trust through subject communities and specialist networks. 
  • Shared CLF curriculum, written and curated by trust experts, reducing individual teacher workload.   
  • Career enhancing and progression opportunities within the trust and through the CLF Institute. 
  • A collaborative culture which supports workload. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking and many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

Closing Date: 10 December 2026 @11.59pm 

Interviews: 16 December 2026

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.    

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Level 1 Teaching Assistant
description:
Job Title: Teaching Assistant – Level 1 

Actual Annual Salary: £18,605 - £20,279 Based on hours and week worked 

Full Time Equivalent Salary: £26,798 - £29,208 (CLF Grade B) Based on full time hours, all year round. 

Contract Type: Fixed Term Contract

Contract Length: Fixed Until 23 July 2027

Hours: 30 hours per week - Part Time, Term Time Only plus Inset days  

Additional information: This role is for 30 hours per week, worked over five days, comprising 6.5 hours per day Monday to Thursday and 4 hours on Friday. Working hours will be aligned to the operational needs of the Academy and the requirements of the role supporting pupils within The Anchor provision.

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

An opportunity to empower students to reach their full potential by delivering tailored support that enhances learning, engagement, and well-being. 

An exciting opportunity to make a meaningful difference in the lives of pupils with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND) by providing tailored support that promotes learning, independence, wellbeing, and personal success. 

Waycroft Academy is seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic Teaching Assistant to join our team on a fixed-term basis, working primarily within The Anchor, our specialist provision supporting pupils with additional SEND needs. This rewarding role is ideal for someone who is passionate about inclusive education and committed to helping every child thrive both academically and personally. 

The successful candidate will work closely with teachers, SEND colleagues, and other professionals to provide high-quality support for pupils with a range of additional needs. You will be confident working independently and as part of a collaborative team, adapting your approach to meet the individual needs of learners and supporting them to access the curriculum, develop confidence, and achieve their full potential. 

You will provide support within the classroom, in small group settings, and through targeted one-to-one interventions, helping pupils to overcome barriers to learning and engage positively in school life. The role will involve supporting pupils' educational, social, emotional, and communication needs, implementing personalised strategies, and contributing to a nurturing and structured learning environment. 

This position would suit an individual who is patient, adaptable, and committed to promoting inclusion. You will play a key role in helping pupils develop independence, resilience, and self-esteem while supporting positive outcomes that enable them to succeed both within school and beyond. 

About You 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is committed to inclusion and ensuring every child feels valued, supported and able to succeed. 
  • Can work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team. 
  • Has a genuine passion for improving the life chances of children and helping them reach their full potential. 
  • Understands the role of a Teaching Assistant and how to support pupils' learning, development and wellbeing within the classroom. 
  • Can build positive relationships with pupils, colleagues, parents and carers. 
  • Can engage and motivate children on a one-to-one basis and within small groups, using positive behaviour management strategies. 
  • Demonstrates patience, empathy, resilience and emotional intelligence when supporting children with a wide range of needs. 
  • Is adaptable and confident in supporting pupils of different ages, abilities and developmental stages, including those with additional needs. 
  • Has strong communication, organisational and interpersonal skills. 
  • Is committed to safeguarding, equality, diversity and promoting the welfare of children and young people. 
  • Holds GCSE English and Maths (Grade C/4 or above) or equivalent, and is willing to undertake relevant training and qualifications to support ongoing development. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.   

About Waycroft Academy: 

Waycroft Academy is a welcoming two-form entry primary school with nursery provision for two, three and four-year-olds, located in the heart of Stockwood, Bristol. Set within extensive grounds, our school offers rich opportunities for outdoor learning that enhance children’s curiosity, well-being and enjoyment of school life. 

We are committed to delivering a broad and balanced curriculum while placing equal importance on the personal development of every child. During our most recent Ofsted inspection, inspectors recognised this strength, commenting: “Staff provide extensive pastoral support. Pupils have wide-ranging experiences to develop their character. Staff champion pupils’ physical and mental well-being.” 

Our shared values of Ready, Respectful and Resilient underpin everything we do and are lived by all members of our school community. Waycroft Academy is a caring, inclusive environment where children and staff support one another to succeed and thrive. 

Why work at CLF?   

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.   

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.  

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay.

title: Sr. Mobile Engineer (iOS and Android) - Travel Industry
description:
Headquarters: LatAm

 About Truelogic
 At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.
 Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.
 By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

 Our Client
 Our client is building a socially connected travel platform that enables users to discover, rent, and exchange homes through trusted personal networks.
 The company has already built an initial mobile product and is preparing for a broader public launch, starting with approximately 200 homes in the United States.
 Our client is now strengthening its engineering team as it transitions away from its previous development provider and moves into the next phase of product development.

 Job Summary
 We are looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer with strong, hands-on experience across both iOS and Android.
 This is a true 50/50 mobile role. Our client is moving away from React Native and toward native mobile development, so the ideal candidate should be equally comfortable building and maintaining applications in:
 Swift / iOS
 Kotlin / Android
 You will work closely with our client's technical leadership and broader product team to help evolve the existing mobile experience, implement new functionality, improve reliability, and support the product as it moves toward public launch.
 PROJECT DURATION: 6 months

 Responsibilities
 • Build and maintain native iOS and Android applications.

• Contribute equally across Swift and Kotlin codebases.

• Help transition the mobile product away from React Native toward native development.

• Work closely with technical leadership on mobile architecture and implementation decisions.

• Implement new product functionality across both platforms.

• Improve stability, performance, maintainability, and overall code quality.

• Support mobile release processes for:
 TestFlight
 Apple App Store
 Google Play

• Collaborate closely with backend engineering and product design.

• Integrate mobile applications with existing backend services and APIs.

• Help establish strong engineering standards and development practices across both mobile platforms.

• Identify technical debt and recommend pragmatic improvements.

• Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and product planning.

• Troubleshoot and resolve mobile-specific bugs and production issues.

• Help ensure feature consistency between iOS and Android.

 Qualifications and Job Requirements
 • Strong professional experience developing native iOS applications with Swift.

• Strong professional experience developing native Android applications with Kotlin.

• Genuine hands-on experience working across both platforms, not primarily one with limited exposure to the other.

• Experience building and maintaining production consumer mobile applications.

• Strong understanding of native mobile architecture and software design patterns.

• Experience integrating mobile applications with REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Experience with mobile authentication, state management, networking, and local persistence.

• Experience with Git-based development workflows.

• Strong debugging and performance optimization skills.

• Experience with App Store and Google Play release processes.

• Ability to work independently in a small, fast-moving engineering team.

 What We Offer
 • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.

• Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market-leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.

• Paid Time Off: We value your well-being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.

• Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.

• Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high-impact projects with Industry-Leading U.S. Companies.

 Why You’ll Like Working Here
 • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well-being and work-life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.

• Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.

• Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you're working with the best in your field.

 Apply now!

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/truelogic-software-sr-mobile-engineer-ios-and-android-travel-industry

title: Growth Product Manager, HTS Media
description:
Headquarters: Toronto - Remote

 About the Role

As a Growth Product Manager, HTS Media, you will own the roadmap for growing advertiser demand across brands: more qualified pipeline, faster campaign launches and higher advertiser spend within Hopper's ecosystem, working closely with engineering leadership, the sales team, Ad Operations and Account Management. This is a builder role: you will start by owning the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, using AI-assisted systems to create demand and make every seller faster, then grow into owning the platform roadmap, including the campaign buying interfaces, in partnership with engineering leadership. In your first year, you'll be judged on the pipeline your systems create, how much faster campaigns go from signed to live, and growth in spend per advertiser.
 What would your day-to-day look like
 • Own the roadmap for sales pipeline and sales efficiency, with goals and success metrics tied to a revenue target

• Build AI-powered systems that generate demand, from account research and signal-based targeting to personalized outreach and follow-up, and measure the pipeline and meetings they produce

• Grow into owning the platform roadmap for the campaign buying interfaces with engineering leadership: write the specs and decide what gets built, and in what order

• Work with Ad Operations to remove friction between a signed campaign and a live one

• Put insights into the buying interface, such as forecasts, benchmarks and media plan recommendations

• Use SQL on booking, search and campaign data to size opportunities, find advertiser results and decide what to build next

• Run demand experiments across channels such as LinkedIn, email and events, and track results in internal dashboards

• Support HTS Media positioning and reusable sales materials (deck templates, one-pagers and case studies), and the HTS Media website and offers site

 An ideal candidate has
 • 4+ years of experience in product management or growth at a technology company, ideally in B2B SaaS, marketplaces or ad tech; experience in online advertising or travel is a plus

• A track record of owning a roadmap and shipping product with engineering that moved a measurable growth metric, such as pipeline, conversion, time to launch or spend per account

• Hands-on experience building AI-assisted or automated workflows that a real sales team used, with tools such as Clay, n8n, Zapier or Make, and LLM APIs (equivalents are fine), and the ability to describe what you built and what it produced

• Strong SQL on a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, and comfort turning booking, search and ad-serving data into decisions, forecasts and in-product insights

• Excellent writing and specification skills, and the ability to work with engineering leadership and communicate clearly with advertisers and internal teams

• Self-driven and organized, and comfortable building without a playbook in a fast-growing business

 Perks and benefits of working with us
 • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

• Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan

• Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage

• HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses

• All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere

• All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay

• Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!

• Unlimited PTO

• Carrot Cash travel stipend

• Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend

• Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

• Open communication with management and company leadership

• Small, dynamic teams = massive impact

 About Hopper

At Hopper, we're building the leading travel technology platform in the world, and we're doing it by solving real problems for real travelers globally. Our Hopper consumer booking platforms and HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), our B2B business, work together to give travelers something the industry has never reliably offered: transparency, flexibility, and real savings on every trip. We combine massive amounts of data and AI with proprietary fintech products to make that happen, not just another booking engine, but a fundamentally better way to plan and experience travel for our customers and our partners. We are proof that better-for-the-customer and better-for-the-business can be one in the same
 And we're continuing to grow fast! The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times, with 70% of our users being Gen Z and Millennials, next-generation travelers. Today, our biggest opportunity is powering travel fintech, commerce, and loyalty for some of the biggest brands in the industry. Our first HTS partnership with Capital One helped launch a dedicated travel portal for a major financial brand's cardholders, and we've since expanded across some of the biggest names in travel and banking, including Air Canada, Uber, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), and Nubank, powering everything from a single fintech integration to a full end-to-end travel loyalty portal.
 That's our trajectory: we started as a small, disruptive app within the travel space, and now we're the engine under the hood powering how Travel Tech works.
 What that looks like in practice:

title: Account Director, Public Sector (DACH)
description:
Headquarters: EMEA

 Build a Safer World.
 TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

 The Account Director will join a team driving TRM's crypto go-to-market strategy for Public Sector customers in the DACH region. Your goal will be to increase and strengthen our foothold in the space. We're looking for a customer-focused , consultative salesperson to own the entire sales process with new and existing customers. This person will be knowledgeable about the cryptocurrency ecosystem and feel comfortable navigating complex processes to close six and seven figure deals.
 The impact you will have here:
 • Account Mapping — Connect with all the current key stakeholders within your territory

• Prospecting — Discover new stakeholders within your territory

• Nurturing — Own, plan, execute, and/or quarterback activities to nurture client relationships, feedback loops, referrals, renewals, upsells, cross-sells, expansions

• Account Planning — Create and execute strategic plans for your territory

• Product and Subject Matter Expertise — Hone TRM product and customer vertical subject matter expertise

• Customer Advocacy — Proactively gather and prioritize customer feedback and champion it within TRM

• Loyalty — Develop a roster of happy customers that will refer new prospects, champion TRM, and provide crucial feedback

 What we're looking for:
 • At least 5+ years of experience selling SaaS products into Public Sector accounts in the DACH region

• Strong customer-facing presentation/listening skills with the ability to establish credibility with senior executives

• A knack for storytelling — ability to understand customer needs and build compelling value propositions

• Adaptable. Goals can change fast. You anticipate and react quickly.

• Autonomous, collaborative and an excellent communicator

 About the Team:
 TRM's EMEA Sales Team has a fast paced, positive and open culture. Team members are given a high degree of responsibility and autonomy. The team gets together for calls regularly. Your manager tries to be available to assist you with questions, problems or at customer meetings.

 Application Instructions
 If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.
 Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.
 If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

 Interviewing with TRM
 Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.
 • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

• Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

• First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

• Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

• References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

• Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

• Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

 Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

 AI Fluency at TRM
 AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.
 We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.
 At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:
 • Accelerate repeatable workflows

• Structure and solve problems

• Improve output quality

• Increase speed and leverage

 You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

 Life at TRM
 We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.
 TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.
 Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.
 At TRM, you should expect:
 • Priorities and targets to change quickly

• Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

• A high level of personal ownership and accountability

• Close collaboration across teams and functions

• Frequent, high-touch communication

• Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

• A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

 This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.
 We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.
 If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

 Leadership Principles
 We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.
 • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

• Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

• Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

 Join our Mission
 At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.
 TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

 Privacy Policy and Additional Information
 By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy .
 We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.
 Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.
 If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com .

TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.
 We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form .

 Recruitment agencies
 TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

title: Global Investigator, Asset Recovery
description:

 Build a Safer World.
 TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks.  The Scam Investigations team is TRM’s tip of the spear against pig butchering syndicates, romance fraud networks, and investment scam operations that steal billions from victims each year. The team operates an integrated workflow — from AI-supported complaint triage to time-sensitive investigation, escalation, and recovery support for victims.
 As a Global Investigator, you will work at the recovery-focused layer of scam investigation. You will validate high-priority blockchain leads, conduct forward and backward tracing, assess whether funds touch regulated platforms or other actionable endpoints, and produce clear investigative documentation that supports time-sensitive escalation and victim-centered recovery outcomes.
 The impact you will have here:
 • Support time-sensitive asset-preservation workflows with regulated platforms and ecosystem partners.

• Own the recovery side . After a freeze, run the backtrace that ties frozen funds to specific victims and produce the documentation that drives restitution. The freeze is the start. Victim recovery is the goal.

• Trace victim funds end-to-end — forward to the wallets that consolidate them, backward to the platforms they came from. Your work feeds directly into the legal packages that recover them.

• Validate time-sensitive blockchain signals and move high-confidence matters through the appropriate escalation workflow. Speed and accuracy both matter.

• Continuously learn new issues in crypto

• Support other teams on time sensitive issues that might be unforeseen

• React timely to the movement of funds during an ongoing investigation

 What we’re looking for:
 • Location / citizenship / clearance — placeholder, varies by region (NA seats: US Citizenship required, ability to obtain Public Trust clearance, US-based). EMEA / APAC seat requirements TBD by region.

• AI fluency (required) — you use AI tools in your workflow to synthesize returns, draft outputs, and accelerate analysis, with examples of how AI has impacted your work.

• Blockchain / cryptocurrency tracing (required, gating) — forward-then-backward trace, exchange attribution, co-mingling handling, multi-hop VASP tracing, and LIFO/FIFO backtrace for recovery work. Non-negotiable.

• Creative tactical thinking — demonstrated ability to pivot from a single point to a network view, identifying operators behind operations.

• Experience producing investigative packages that can support formal legal, compliance, or enforcement workflows.

• You think in outcomes, not lanes. If “that’s not what I was hired for” is a sentence you reach for, this isn’t the seat.

• You don’t need a checklist to start. Handed something you’ve never seen, you figure out the first move and take it. When the playbook stops, you keep going.

• 3–5 years of cryptocurrency investigations or asset-recovery experience — law enforcement crypto units, blockchain analytics firms, exchange compliance investigations, or equivalent. You understand how regulated platforms behave under request, including the difference between voluntary cooperation and formal process, and you treat getting money back to victims as part of your job rather than a downstream handoff.

 Learn about TRM Speed in this position:
 • Surge availability expected during time-sensitive disruption windows

• All output documented in Notion and TRM’s investigative tools

• Weekly team syncs

• Daily shift handoff call

• Daily monitoring shift

 Team operating rhythms:
 • High autonomy, high standards, low bureaucracy — work directly with engineering, analysts, legal counterparts, and partners who depend on the team’s output.

• Distributed, async-first via Slack and Notion, with structured syncs for alignment.

• Follow-the-sun rotation — the team runs investigators across NA, EMEA, and APAC for around-the-clock coverage.

 On-Call Responsibilities:
 • Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

• Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

title: Senior Strategic Account Executive (Accounts 1 billion+)
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimize operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimized consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As a Senior Strategic Account Executive, you own the development and growth of a portfolio of assigned strategic accounts within your designated region. You build and execute strategic sales plans, develop trusted relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders, and identify opportunities to expand Rithum's value across complex client organizations. You are accountable for meeting or exceeding financial targets by leading consultative, value-based sales engagements and securing high-value, multi-year software and services agreements.

Rithum empowers employees across all roles to leverage AI and technology to work smarter, move faster, and create scalable ways of working. In this role, you will use AI and data-driven insights to strengthen account strategy, identify opportunities, improve sales effectiveness, and deliver more relevant and impactful client engagement.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Growth

  • Develop and execute account plans aligned to client priorities, commerce strategies, and growth objectives.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets by identifying, developing, and closing software and services opportunities.
  • Expand Rithum’s footprint across client brands, business units, geographies, channels, marketplaces, and capabilities.
  • Build qualified pipeline by identifying whitespace and new opportunities within assigned accounts.

Executive & Value-Based Selling

  • Build trusted, multi-threaded relationships with senior executives and key stakeholders.
  • Understand client priorities and position Rithum’s capabilities against business outcomes.
  • Lead consultative, value-based conversations and develop compelling business cases.
  • Navigate complex buying groups and build consensus across decision-makers.

Deal Execution

  • Lead complex sales opportunities from discovery through negotiation and close.
  • Develop deal strategies that address client priorities, competitive dynamics, commercial considerations, and barriers to close.
  • Lead negotiations across pricing, terms, procurement, legal, security, and other stakeholders.
  • Apply the Rithum Way of Selling to opportunity strategy, qualification, progression, and close.

Pipeline, Forecasting & AI

  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline and deliver accurate, timely forecasts.
  • Maintain high-quality CRM data and use insights to prioritize accounts and opportunities.
  • Leverage AI and sales technologies to strengthen research, account planning, client engagement, and productivity.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional deal teams, bringing together the expertise needed to advance opportunities and deliver client value.
  • Partner across Client Success, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Product, Partnerships, Legal, Finance, and other teams as needed.
  • Share client, market, and competitive insights with Product and business leadership.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of B2B software, SaaS, or technology sales experience
  • 5+ years in a closing role selling to strategic or enterprise accounts, or 2+ years selling Rithum solutions to enterprise clients, with quota attainment
  • Proven success in a full cycle quota carrying role; from strategic territory planning, prospecting, developing & closing complex 6 figure transactions (minimum 100k deal size)
  • Consistent recent quota attainment (100%+ for 4+ consecutive quarters) in a competitive, metrics-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated success developing and growing strategic accounts through new opportunities, expansion, cross-sell, upsell, or new use cases.
  • Experience leading complex sales cycles involving senior executives, multiple stakeholders, and commercial negotiations.
  • Mastery of structured, value-based sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDICC, Challenger, SPIN, Miller Heiman, Value Selling, Solution Selling) with evidence of pipeline progression and forecast accuracy, translating solutions into measurable business outcomes and leading cross-functional deal teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through self-generated outbound prospecting, with measurable activity standards (e.g., 40–60+ daily touchpoints)
  • Demonstrated ability to develop account plans, identify whitespace, build pipeline, and maintain accurate forecasts.
  • Disciplined use of CRM and sales tools (Salesforce preferred) and sales engagement platforms (e.g., Outreach, Salesloft, HubSpot, LinkedIn Navigator, ZoomInfo) for pipeline, activity, and conversion tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI, data, and modern sales technologies to improve sales effectiveness.
  • Ability to operate independently and travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS, software, or technology sales experience.
  • Experience selling enterprise commerce, e-commerce, marketplace, retail technology, or related solutions.
  • Experience selling to large brands, retailers, manufacturers, or enterprises with complex buying environments.
  • Experience selling integrated solutions across multiple products, capabilities, or services.
  • Familiarity with partner- or channel-influenced sales motions.
  • Experience positioning data-driven or AI-powered solutions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred.

Travel Required

Up to 25%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Partner with the leading brands and retailers.
  • Connect with passionate professionals who will help support your goals.
  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

Benefits

  • Enhanced Private Medical Insurance and a Health Cash Back Plan
  • Life insurance & disability benefits
  • Pension plan with 4% Company match
  • Competitive time off package with 25 Days of PTO, 9 Company-paid Holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 10 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days and 1 Paid Volunteer Day
  • £45/month Remote work stipend for internet
  • Access to tools to support your wellbeing such as the Calm App and an Employee Assistance Program
  • Professional development stipend and learning and development offerings to help you build the skills and connections you need to move forward in your career
  • Peer-to-peer recognition tool; earn points to redeem for gift cards, swag, and more
  • Charitable contribution match per team member

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with the law for qualified applicants. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. Your comfort and accessibility are important to us, and we're here to ensure a seamless experience as you explore opportunities with our team.

title: Demand Generation & Campaign Operations Manager
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

You run our websites, search, webinars and email across the Spotify Technology portfolio. Your job is to bring people into the funnel and move them through it: from finding us in search or at a webinar, to signing up, to becoming an active user, to a meeting with sales. You also own the numbers. Every week you tell the team what’s working, what isn’t and what we’re changing. You work AI-first, you know our martech stack inside out, and you use the newest features of both.

What You'll Do

  • Website, personalization and SEO: Own performance on our marketing sites, including landing pages, forms and conversion paths. Create personalized experiences using the latest tools. Own GA4 and GTM tracking and run A/B tests to lift conversion. Implement SEO and AI search strategies and decide which pages we need to build next.

  • Email and nurture, moving people toward sales: Build nurture paths mapped to each stage from lead to opportunity with a clear next step. Segment by role, company fit and intent so engineers, platform leads and execs each get the right message. Partner with Sales and RevOps on what sales-ready looks like, keep a regular drumbeat for people who aren’t ready yet, and write the emails yourself. Success is measured by meetings booked and pipeline, not opens and clicks.

  • Webinars, getting the most out of every one: Run every webinar end to end, from platform and landing page to invites and reminders. Grow registrations and show rate with the right audience, and manage the follow ups. Turn each webinar into on-demand pages, clips, blog posts and nurture content. Report results and keep a playbook of what works.

  • Campaign operations: Own campaign naming and UTM rules. Build and launch your own emails, workflows, segments and lists, backed by standard QA checklists. Keep lists clean and own subscription types and consent setup, including growing opted-in lists across the portfolio. Partner with Legal on consent, privacy and data sharing so every list enters HubSpot correctly and legally.

  • Reporting: Build reporting at campaign, channel and executive levels, and own the weekly scorecard. Track spend and tool costs against pipeline, decide with the team what to scale, fix or stop.

  • AI and martech: Work AI-first every day and know our stack inside out, using the newest features as they ship. Structure our data so AI tools return correct answers. Build AI agents and automations that cut manual work, evaluate new tools on cost and impact, and be the team’s go-to person for what the tools can do.

Who You Are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in demand gen, marketing ops or lifecycle at B2B SaaS, selling to developers or technical buyers

  • You’ve set up marketing from scratch: tracking, email, reporting, the works. You’re comfortable in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • You’ve built nurture programs that moved leads to sales meetings, and can show the pipeline

  • You enjoy hands-on, individual contributor work and building programs yourself

  • You’ve run webinar programs end to end

title: Field Marketing and Events Manager
description:
Rithum™ is the world’s most trusted commerce network, accelerating how brands, suppliers, and retailers work together to deliver seamless e-commerce experiences. We provide an unmatched platform for brands and retailers, enabling them to accelerate growth, optimise operations across channels, scale product offerings and enhance margins.

Today, more than 40,000 companies trust Rithum to grow their business across hundreds of channels, representing over $50 billion in annual GMV. Using our commerce, marketing, and delivery solutions, our customers create optimised consumer shopping journeys from beginning to end.

Overview

As the Field Marketing & Events Manager, you own Rithum’s field marketing and events program across assigned regions and play a defined role in executing the events calendar. You design and deliver a portfolio that spans client conferences, industry trade shows, internal company gatherings, executive dinners, and multi-city roadshows. You are accountable for the demand those programs generate, including leads, pipeline, and client engagement, and for the localized marketing strategy that connects them to Rithum’s business objectives within assigned regions. Working with senior marketing leadership and regional sales, you define what success looks like for field marketing, build the processes that make strong events repeatable, and deliver experiences that raise Rithum’s brand visibility with clients and industry leaders.

At Rithum, all team members are expected to leverage AI to work smarter, accelerate decision-making, automate repeatable work, and improve outcomes. You are encouraged to continuously identify opportunities to apply AI, data, and scalable processes to enhance productivity, drive innovation, and deliver greater value for our clients, partners, and teams while maintaining appropriate judgment, quality, security, and compliance.

Responsibilities

Regional Strategy & Events Planning

  • Define and execute the field events plan within assigned regions, setting clear objectives and measurable goals for brand visibility and business impact
  • Partner with field marketing and sales leadership to plan and execute events within the global field plan, with clear ownership agreed for each event
  • Develop and execute localized marketing strategies that drive demand, generate leads, and accelerate the sales pipeline across markets within assigned regions

Event Delivery & Execution

  • Plan and execute a broad range of events, from high-touch executive dinners to mid-scale multi-city roadshows, each with defined objectives, tracking, and measurement
  • Lead end-to-end event execution, including budgeting, pre- and post-event marketing, on-site and offsite experience and logistics, vendor management, and post-event analysis
  • Coordinate across time zones with sales, field, and event vendors so that execution standards, timelines, and handoffs are consistent between regions

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Track event performance against attendance, leads generated, opportunities and pipeline generated, and client feedback, and present actionable insight to stakeholders
  • Build repeatable processes, templates, and post-event review practices that deliver consistent results across all regions and calendars, not just through individual effort, and apply a single measurement standard throughout

AI-Enabled Practice

  • Use AI to improve the quality of event planning and performance decisions, not only the speed of delivery, surfacing alternatives and stress-testing assumptions before committing budget
  • Model and share effective AI practices with the wider marketing team, and be clear about what must be verified before AI-assisted material reaches clients or partners

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across sales, marketing, content, product, and client success, as well as external partners, to deliver seamless events aligned with business goals
  • Leverage company websites, online content, industry trends, and emerging technologies to enhance the client experience and event effectiveness

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years in field or corporate events marketing within an enterprise B2B software or e-commerce organization, with experience across multiple regions and markets
  • Previous experience in events and field marketing within the e-commerce sector, engaging e-commerce audiences
  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing large industry events, including Shoptalk, NRF, eTail
  • Strong working knowledge of the B2B technology ecosystem and of regional differences in event strategy, audience engagement, and execution
  • Successful ownership and management of event budgets across varying scales and complexity
  • Proven experience planning and executing events with clearly defined budgets, objectives, and measurable KPIs, pre- and post-event
  • Working knowledge of core marketing metrics and their application in measuring event success and field marketing impact
  • Experience with event management tools and platforms such as Asana, Marketo, Cvent, Salesforce, HubSpot, and virtual event platforms
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent events to deadline across more than one market and time zone
  • Experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders, including Sales and Client Success, to align marketing initiatives with broader business objectives
  • Ability to travel globally on a regular basis for events, with authorization to work and travel internationally
  • Experience using AI tools to improve marketing or events work, including planning, analysis, content development, and reporting, with verification of output before it reaches clients or partners

Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years in field or corporate events management within B2B technology, software, or e-commerce
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field
  • Previous experience in events and field marketing within the e-commerce sector, engaging e-commerce audiences
  • Experience supporting events in both EMEA and North America across diverse industries and market segments
  • Experience working directly with sales to drive measurable results
  • London-based, with the ability to travel to the office, as this role collaborates closely with the regional sales team and a global field marketing team

Travel Required

25% - 40%

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What it’s like to work at Rithum

When you join Rithum, you can expect to work with smart risk-takers, courageous collaborators, and curious minds.

As part of the Rithum team, you are valued, supported, and included. Guided by a transparent culture and accessible, approachable leadership, we offer career opportunities aligned to your ambitions and talents. To ensure work and life balance works for you, we also offer an array of resources to support you and your families, including comprehensive benefits and wellness plans.

At Rithum you will:

  • Participate in an inclusive, welcoming work atmosphere.
  • Achieve work-life balance through remote-first working conditions, generous time off, and wellness days.
  • Receive industry-competitive compensation and total rewards benefits.

Benefits

  • Life insurance & disability benefits
  • Pension plan with 4% Company match
  • Competitive time off package with 25 Days of PTO, 9 Company-paid Holidays, 2 paid floating holidays, 10 paid sick days, 2 Wellness days and 1 Paid Volunteer Day

  • Peer-to-peer recognition tool; earn points to redeem for gift cards, swag, and more

Rithum is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. If you require assistance during the interview process due to a medical condition or need support accessing our website or completing the application process, please reach out to us by completing the Accommodations Request Form. title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Japan

 Who we are:
 Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products.

 Our culture:
 • We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation.

• We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule.

• We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless.

 Location:
 • Remote - Japan

 About the role
 As we expand globally, we’re looking for passionate QA automation engineer. You’ll be part of global QA team, working closely with both global team and client-facing team in APAC region. This role requires business-level English and Japanese skills.
 You will design a clear set of test scenarios, decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and work with stakeholders across Engineering, Product, Professional Services, and our clients, including banks.
 What you'll be doing
 • Own automated coverage for APIs and client-facing dashboard in sandbox and production

• Be the named QA on APAC bank integrations: structured test scenarios, UAT support, regression tests.

• Set the automation strategy for the surface you own: what runs in CI, what stays exploratory, and what is better left manual.

• Work with engineers across the full SDLC and shift left. Join design and planning so quality is in the conversation before code is written.

• Find, record, and document defects so engineer and customer partners can both act on them.

• Partner with Professional Services and Post-Sales on structured acceptance testing for bank and enterprise deployments.

• Own the health of the suites you run in CI so failures are real and actionable.

 What you'll bring
 • Strong hands-on automation (API first, in TypeScript or JavaScript), with a clear strategy for what to automate. Our suites run on Cypress; Playwright or similar experience transfers.

• You can organize test scenarios so someone else can read the map: scope, priority, automation vs. evidence.

• 5+ years in software quality, including owning a product or integration end to end.

• Great written and verbal communication skills in English and Japanese for both internal and external communication.

• Strong ownership on everything around quality

• Hands-on with CI and a habit of keeping suites maintainable.

• Experience in Software Engineering is a plus

• Experience in working SaaS company is a plus

 Nice to have: experience with banks or regulators in APAC (for example data privacy under APPI in Japan); Cypress or similar for the occasional UI path; reading Go (our services and their unit tests); Qase or another test-management tool; prior file-based or batch testing.

 Benefits we offer:
 • Generous compensation in cash and equity

• Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested

• Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture

• Flexible paid time off and Year-end break

• Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific

• 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific

• MacBook Pro delivered to your door

• One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc.

• Monthly meal stipend

• Monthly social meet-up stipend

• Annual health and wellness stipend

• Annual Learning stipend

 Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world. If you are seeking a meaningful career, you found the right place, and we would love to hear from you.

 To learn more about how we process your personal information and your rights in regards to your personal information as an applicant and Sardine employee, please visit our Applicant and Worker Privacy Notice .

title: Manager, Concierge Partnerships
description:
Headquarters:

 URL: http://www.wunderkind.co

 About Wunderkind:

 Wunderkind is a performance marketing solution that uses AI and data to help brands acquire and retain customers through one-to-one, personalized messages across websites, email, text, and ads, guaranteeing a lift in revenue. Founded in 2010, Our goal is to scale a brand’s ability to create and grow customer relationships through websites, email, text, and ads. We believe individuals should have the freedom to choose the kind of internet they want. An internet that fosters genuine relationships with brands. An internet that treats humans like real people instead of “web traffic.” We also believe in empowering brands to treat their customers as individuals, satisfying their unique needs with tailored experiences and thoughtful communication. By expertly personalizing, automating, and scaling beautiful one-to-one experiences, Wunderkind helps brands acquire new customers at scale and keep them loyal for life.

 About the Role:

 We’re hiring a Concierge Partnerships Manager to sit on our Partnerships team and grow Concierge, Wunderkind’s referral partner program. You’ll recruit and activate a network of e-commerce operators, former clients, and industry insiders who make warm introductions to brands, then help carry those introductions through to closed-won revenue. You’ll work alongside our existing Concierge lead to scale the program. This is a commercially-oriented role focused on revenue and new deal flow , not just leads or partner sign-ups.

 Role Responsibilities:

• Concierge partner recruitment

• Source and sign net new Concierge referral partners, including e-commerce operators, former Wunderkind clients, agency and ESP alumni, and entrepreneurs-in-residence.

• Pitch the program to prospective partners: how Wunderkind helps brands, what makes a strong referral, and how partners earn fees at the SQL, SAO, and closed-won stages.

• Pipeline generation and deal influence

• Turn partner introductions into qualified meetings and SAOs, and hand each one to the right AE quickly with the context they need.

• Stay involved through the sales cycle, using partner relationships to influence opportunities through to closed-won.

• Track and report against SQLs, SAOs, pipeline value, and closed-won revenue attributed to Concierge partners.

• Partner activation, community & events

• Keep partners engaged with regular check-ins, target account lists, and talk tracks, and re-activate partners who have gone quiet.

• Work with the sales team to map partner networks against target accounts so introductions land where Wunderkind fits best.

• Plan and host Concierge events, dinners, and partner community gatherings, including events co-hosted with ESP and agency partners, that generate introductions and accelerate deals.

• Internal coordination & reporting

• Work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, RevOps, and Finance to align Concierge with our ESP and agency motions and to process referral payouts accurately.

• Maintain a clean view of partner-influenced pipeline, forecast, and performance; communicate wins, gaps, and next moves.

 What success looks like:

• Concierge is directly tied to revenue: measurable sourced and influenced ARR, not just partner sign-ups and intros.

• A growing, active bench of referral partners sends Wunderkind qualified introductions every quarter.

• Clear visibility into partner activity, pipeline, and payouts across the Concierge program.

 Required Qualifications:

• 3+ years in partnerships, referral or channel programs, business development, or sales in martech/adtech, e-commerce, or SaaS.

• Proven track record of hitting or exceeding revenue targets tied to partner or referral programs.

• A strong network in e-commerce, retail, or DTC marketing, and the ability to build trusted relationships quickly with operators and executives.

• Strong commercial instincts: you think in terms of pipeline, coverage, conversion, and deal strategy, not just relationship-building.

• Comfortable working with AEs and the broader sales team; you know how to hand off an introduction and help move a deal forward.

• Excellent communicator and operator – able to host events, manage a book of partners, and report clearly on outcomes.

 The base salary range for this role is $85,000.00 to $95,000.00. The compensation package includes variable earnings. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each specific candidate; including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, applicable certifications, and geographic work location. Our pay bands include different levels for different USA states, so salaries may vary depending on living location and market rate.

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/wunderkind-manager-concierge-partnerships

description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Marketer that can position & package the ElevenAgents Platform to Enterprise. Companies around the world use ElevenLabs Agents to resolve customer support, provide engaging and interactive experiences, and put an end to “waiting on hold”. We continue to discover new use cases and industries that can benefit from our technology and you’ll be helping drive the narrative as we grow. You’ll help launch new products, produce thought leadership content, create assets to enable our sales team, and build industry focused landing pages.

Who You Are

We're looking for an exceptional individual who combines a great product & design sense, excellent copy writing skills, and the technical background and interest to become an expert on Conversational Agents.

You’ll thrive on our team if you:

  • Are extremely passionate about AI Audio and technology more generally.

  • Have experience launching products and creating content for technical / enterprise audiences.

  • Have excellent project management skills and can juggle multiple tasks at once.

  • Consistently strive for excellence, delivering high-quality work quickly and exceeding expectations.

  • Take initiative and work autonomously from day one, prioritizing learning and contribution while leaving ego aside.

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote
