title: Senior Strategic Account Executive (Central EMEA)
description:
Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive (German Speaking).

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on DACH. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and revenue growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.
  • Growing our revenue and share of wallet within your key account list.
  • Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.
  • Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.
  • Selling solutions to a technical and business audience.
  • Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 7+ years of Account Management/Sales experience covering selling and closing complex technical solutions to a large customer base.
  • History of working with accounts ranging from large multinational enterprise customers to Digital Natives.
  • Demonstrated success by achieving quota on a consistent basis.
  • Track record of Account Management experience and a solid understanding of how to cross and upsell solutions within a mature customer base.
  • A solid understanding of financial reporting within a direct customer base - Revenue tracking
  • German language proficiency

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience.
  • Experience and understanding of working in the communications market is preferable. Have sold or worked with Messaging, Voice Calling, Email, Account Security Verification. Or have prior experience in a traditional telecommunications environment/business.
  • Curious networker
  • Strong emotional intelligence

Location

The position will be remote and based in the United Kingdom, Ireland or Spain.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.
.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

 As a Sr. Staff Technical Program Manager for Search Signals at Pinterest, you will lead company-level programs that are foundational to Pinterest’s strategic transformation into a shopping and inspiration platform. This role is responsible for driving innovation and execution across offsite signals, content understanding, and relevance, with direct impact on multiple company OKRs. You will operate at the intersection of technical depth, cross-org influence, and long-term business strategy, shaping the future of search and personalization at Pinterest.

 What you’ll do:

 Strategic Leadership & Vision

• Envision and trailblaze the company’s approach to leveraging offsite and onsite signals, anticipating future business, technical, and regulatory challenges.

• Drive the creation and evolution of the company-wide roadmap for signals, aligning business objectives with technical capabilities and directly impacting multiple company OKRs.

• Identify opportunities for long-term business innovation and differentiation, ensuring Pinterest remains at the forefront of search and recommendation technologies.

 Program Execution & Outcomes

• Oversee and deliver company-level programs that span multiple organizations, managing ambiguity and risk at scale.

• Lead the technical execution and delivery of signals initiatives, ensuring on-time, high-quality results across interconnected projects.

• Develop and achieve program-specific metrics and targets, driving the resolution of complex technical and program management challenges through conceptual and innovative thinking.

 Influence & Cross-Org Leadership

• Influence at the VP/staff level, providing thought leadership in program and product management across Pinterest.

• Guide and motivate teams, fostering an environment of accountability, inclusion, and high performance.

• Serve as the primary liaison with AI Research teams and other partner organizations to accelerate the adoption of new models (LLMs, VLMs, recommender systems) and ensure seamless integration into core Pinterest experiences.

 Collaboration & Communication

• Evangelize the vision and progress of signals programs to all levels of leadership, including the Executive Team, ensuring clear, concise, and impactful communication.

• Drive consensus and propose informed tradeoffs across the company, balancing technical, business, and regulatory considerations.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, and external data partners.

 Technical & Domain Expertise

• Demonstrate expert technical understanding and judgment, guiding teams in solving complex technical challenges that span organizations.

• Author and advance best practices, tools, and methodologies for signals management, data acquisition, and model evaluation.

• Shape the future of the signals domain at Pinterest through continuous research, learning, and mentorship of program managers and technical leads.

 AI-first execution & workflow design

• Use GenAI as the default operating model for TPM execution—starting from AI-assisted first drafts of core artifacts (charters, roadmaps, status reports, decision memos, RAID logs) and modernizing high-toil workflows (status synthesis, risk/dependency tracking, intake triage) into AI-first mechanisms where appropriate.

• Prototype lightweight AI-powered helpers and tools (“vibe coding”) to improve signal quality monitoring, experiment readouts, and decision-making across Search and Signals.

• Follow Pinterest AI guidance for risk, governance, and safety-by-design—appropriately handling sensitive data, validating AI-generated outputs, documenting assumptions/limits, and ensuring AI-assisted workflows meet applicable policy/compliance expectations before broad adoption.

 What we’re looking for:

• BS in a technical discipline or equivalent experience (10+ years in technical or analytical roles, with significant program leadership at company scale).

• Demonstrated ability to lead transformational, company-level programs with direct impact on multiple OKRs.

• Deep technical breadth and judgment, with expertise in search, recommendation systems, ML/AI, and large-scale data integration.

• AI-forward execution mindset – demonstrated ability to use GenAI to accelerate planning, program operations, and stakeholder communications at company scale—starting from AI drafts and applying strong judgment to validate, refine, and drive decisions.

• Workflow design, AI fluency, and data orientation – experience turning repeatable program work into durable, low-toil mechanisms and improving decision quality using GenAI, data analysis, and automation (including “vibe-coding” small helpers or scripts with AI coding assistants).

• Safety-by-design AI fluency – experience operating within AI governance expectations (risk assessment, sensitive data handling, model/output validation, auditability/traceability) and proactively identifying where AI use is not appropriate or requires additional controls.

• Proven track record of influencing at the VP/staff level and driving consensus across complex, cross-functional environments.

• Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and organizational awareness.

• Experience with legal, privacy, and regulatory compliance in data-driven environments.

• Experience working with external data partners and negotiating data acquisition agreements is highly desirable.

• Experience with internationalization and supporting global product relevance is a plus

title: Product Marketing Manager - Banking & Payments
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 In 1933, Harry Beck introduced a radically different map of the London Underground. Rather than faithfully depicting the geography of London, he simplified the sprawling transit network into clean lines, clear connections, and a system that anyone could navigate. Distances were distorted, angles were standardized, and unnecessary details disappeared. The result was something far more useful than a geographically accurate map: a way for millions of people to understand a complex system and confidently find their way through it.

 Beck understood something fundamental. The best way to explain something complicated isn't to show people everything. It's to understand what matters to them and make that unmistakably clear.

 At Mercury, we believe great product marketing works the same way. Banking* and payments can be complex, but the value they create for customers shouldn't be. Our job is to understand what people need, find the essence of what we're building, and help customers see how it can make their lives better.

 We're a financial technology company building products that help ambitious businesses do more with their money. From everyday banking and payments to international money movement and emerging capabilities like agentic payments, we're making complex financial workflows feel remarkably simple.

 We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to help bring these products to market, communicate their value, and make sure customers discover and use what we're building.

 This role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, and Revenue. You'll develop positioning, lead go-to-market strategies, drive successful product launches, and identify opportunities to increase adoption and revenue.

 We care deeply about craft, but successful product marketing is about more than a beautiful campaign or a well-executed announcement. It's about understanding customers, building an effective plan, and driving meaningful results.

 *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

 In this role, you'll:

• Lead impactful product launches. Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy and execution for new banking and payments capabilities, including emerging agentic features. Develop launch plans, align cross-functional teams, prepare customer-facing partners, and measure impact on product adoption and business goals.

• Get close to our customers. Build a deep understanding of how founders and finance teams manage money, what challenges they face, and why they choose one financial product over another. Turn these insights into compelling positioning, messaging, and GTM strategies.

• Execute AI-first. Use AI to work smarter, move faster, and produce better outcomes. You’ll build and use existing workflows, automations, and repeatable processes that improve how you approach research, launch execution, competitive intelligence, and other core responsibilities.

• Help more customers discover and use Mercury. Partner with Product, Lifecycle, Activation, and Revenue to drive adoption of banking and payments capabilities. Identify growth opportunities, test hypotheses, and improve product usage over time.

• Become an expert on our market. Develop a sharp understanding of the banking and payments competitive landscape, including emerging fintech products and traditional financial institutions. Translate market insights into differentiated positioning and actionable recommendations.

• Equip our Revenue teams to win. Build trusted relationships with customer-facing teams and develop the competitive intelligence, battlecards, messaging, and training they need to communicate Mercury's value confidently and accurately.

• Work with exceptional cross-functional partners. Collaborate with Product, Brand, Creative, Lifecycle, and Revenue to bring go-to-market strategies to life. Help shape strong campaign briefs and channel strategies, drawing on specialized creative expertise when needed.

• Connect marketing to business impact. Define clear objectives for launches and growth initiatives, track meaningful performance indicators, and communicate what worked, what didn't, and what we should do next.

• Own the full picture. Manage multiple projects and product areas simultaneously, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and prioritize the work that will have the greatest impact on Mercury and its customers.

 You might be a great fit if you:

• Have 2-3 years of B2B product marketing experience and have taken meaningful ownership of product launches and go-to-market initiatives.

• Have successfully brought new products or features to market and can explain the business impact of your work.

• Know how to build a complete GTM strategy, from customer insight and positioning through launch execution, field readiness, and post-launch measurement.

• Are an AI-native operator who goes beyond using AI for basic tasks. You've built workflows, automations, or systems that meaningfully improve the efficiency or quality of your work and your team's, and you're constantly experimenting with new ways to work better.

• Are deeply curious about customers and naturally look for the insights behind their behaviors, needs, and decisions.

• Can translate complex products and capabilities into clear, compelling messaging.

• Understand that great product marketing extends beyond launches into product adoption, competitive positioning, and revenue growth.

• Are comfortable using customer feedback, data, and experimentation to evaluate and improve marketing performance.

• Enjoy working closely with Product, Marketing, and Revenue teams and know how to build trusted relationships across functions.

• Can manage several competing priorities, make good decisions with incomplete information, and independently move important work forward.

• Experience in fintech, banking*, or payments is a plus, but it's not required. We're equally interested in people who have done exceptional work in other B2B industries and are excited to learn something new.

title: Open Call for Founders / Founding Teams - Product Management and Engineering
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within Canada or United States

 Open call for Founders / Founding Teams (Product Management / Engineering roles)

 In 1973 at Xerox PARC, Bob Metcalfe sketched a way for many computers to share a single wire — borrowing the throughput math from his study of Hawaii's ALOHAnet — and he and David Boggs built it and measured it until it held. Behind Ethernet was a two-person team that turned a contested idea into the measured standard now carrying almost all the world's wired traffic.

At Mercury, we’re looking to accelerate several of our AI products that our customers love like Command, CLI, and MCP. We’re building for ambitious people of all kinds, and are a company made of founders and small technical teams trying to change the world - as part of that, we’re taking open applications for founders or small technical teams (Eng+) that want to work together on building the AI products of the future. This isn't a fixed role. We expect the nature of work is changing, and small teams of people paired with AI product surface and autonomy to build can create 10x outcomes. Apply as a small team or as an individual

Here are some things you’ll do on the job:

• Find the problem. Work close enough to customers that you spot what matters before anyone assigns it to you — then decide it's worth building.

• Build and automate the workflow end to end using Command, CLI, MCP, and the rest of our AI stack.

• Ship to customers fast — quick understanding, tight iteration, deploy.

• Measure the impact honestly, then do the next one. Kill what didn't move; double down on what did.

description:
Headquarters: Remote UK

 At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 At Affirm, we’re reimagining how people access and experience financial products. Our commitment to clarity, honesty, and empathy fuels every design decision across all of our user experiences. We’re looking for a Content Designer II to help create clear, useful, trustworthy, and compelling product experiences that make it easier for people to understand and use Affirm.

 About the team

 In this role, you’ll work as an embedded partner on a product team, collaborating closely with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience. You’ll help design and improve product experiences from discovery through launch, experimentation, and optimization, with a focus on both thoughtful content strategy and precise UX writing.

 You’ll bring strong writing skills, customer empathy, and product thinking to important product work. You’ll ask thoughtful questions, explain your rationale clearly, and advocate for simple, transparent experiences that help customers make informed decisions. You’ll use content strategy, systems thinking, and UX writing to help teams create experiences that are simple, transparent, and customer-centered.

 You’ll also contribute to Affirm’s growing Content Design practice by sharing feedback, participating in team rituals, helping strengthen guidelines and patterns, and partnering with other content designers. This role is ideal for a collaborative, curious, and customer-oriented content designer who is ready to grow their craft while making meaningful contributions to product experiences.

What You’ll Do

•
 Contribute content design to product work, shaping user flows, information architecture, content hierarchy, UX writing, and customer communications across web and native app experiences.

•
 Work cross-functionally with Product Design, Research, Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Legal, Compliance, and Customer Experience from early ideas through launch and optimization.

•
 Help teams understand customer problems, identify content and usability opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about how product experiences should work and communicate.

•
 Write clear, accurate, concise, and human product content across in-product flows, notifications, emails, text messages, prototypes, and other customer touchpoints.

•
 Use research, experimentation, customer feedback, and data to improve content decisions, usability, and customer understanding.

•
 Participate in design sprints, critique, content reviews, and product discussions as an advocate for clarity, accessibility, and content-first design.

•
 Help strengthen Affirm’s content design practice by contributing to style guides, writing guidelines, reusable patterns, team artifacts, and shared ways of working.

What We Look For

•
 2+ years of experience in content design, UX writing, content strategy, information architecture, or a related field, with experience designing for web and native digital products.

•
 A portfolio that shows strong UX writing craft, strategic thinking, and shipped product experiences across in-app, web, or other customer touchpoints.

•
 Strong understanding of UX writing, information architecture, content hierarchy, usability, accessibility, research, experimentation, and product development.

•
 Ability to work independently on defined projects, navigate ambiguity with support, connect content decisions to customer needs and business goals, and move work forward with care.

•
 Experience collaborating with PMs, designers, researchers, engineers, legal, compliance, marketing, or brand partners to shape clear and effective product experiences.

•
 Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain rationale, invite feedback, build alignment, and advocate for the customer.

•
 Nice to have: experience in financial services, regulated industries, native app experiences, design systems, lifecycle communications, or AI-enabled content workflows.

description:
Headquarters: Remote - South Africa

 Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

 We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

 Role

 We are looking for an Account Executive to join our South Africa GTM team. This is a Hybrid role reporting to the Sales Director.

 You will join a global group of professionals passionate about cloud security and driving a secure, cloud-enabled digital future. In this role, you will demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation by managing a territory focused on net new logos and up-sell opportunities.

 What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Take ownership of East & West Africa + SADC countries (Exc South Africa) focused on net new logo and up-sell opportunities within commercial accounts.

• Demonstrate expertise in building business cases that clearly show value and differentiation at all levels of customer and prospect organizations

• Partner effectively with Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture, Value Consulting, and Transformation teams throughout your sales cycles

• Drive consistent pipeline generation using modern techniques, joint field marketing initiatives, and top-tier channel partners including VARs, SIs, and SPs

• Execute a disciplined sales process from beginning to end while maintaining a high level of accountability for your territory's growth

 Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.

• You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.

• You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.

• You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.

• You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

 What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• At least 5 years of sales experience selling to customers with a revenue quota, specifically selling to commercial accounts in the relevant advertised territories

• History of a consistent track record of over-achievement in net new logo accomplishments and a strong understanding of how to leverage channel partnerships

• Demonstrated willingness to be coached and the discipline to follow a proven sales process from start to finish

• Proven ability to lead 'team sales' by effectively utilizing internal resources, partners, and team members to achieve success

 What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Experience leveraging AI-powered sales intelligence tools, conversational AI, or predictive pipeline analytics to accelerate commercial deal velocity

• Previous experience selling security, SaaS, or enterprise software solutions in the relevant advertised territories

• Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field of study

description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 About the Role

 Abnormal AI is looking for a Director of Customer Success, Public Sector to lead the team that drives adoption, retention, and expansion across our federal, state, local, and education customers.

• Why Abnormal. We are an AI-native cybersecurity company protecting organizations from the most sophisticated email and identity-based attacks. We hold FedRAMP Moderate authorization and GovRAMP authorization, so agencies and public institutions can adopt our platform with confidence.

• Why this role. You will own Customer Success for one of the fastest-growing parts of our business, with real autonomy to shape the model. You will lead a high-performing team of Customer Success Managers, build executive relationships across agencies and public organizations, and set the standard for how Abnormal serves government customers. The mission is hard to match: you are helping protect the people and institutions that serve the public.

• Why now. As we expand our federal presence, we need a leader with deep public sector experience, an established network, and a long-term commitment to this space to take the team to its next level.

 You will partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Channel, Support, and Product to create clear ownership and a consistent customer experience. This role reports to the VP of Customer Success.

 What you will do

• Lead, coach, and grow a team of Customer Success Managers serving federal and SLED customers. Build trust with a strong existing team and create room for them to take on more.

• Define and execute the Public Sector Customer Success strategy, including coverage models, success planning, and playbooks tailored to federal and SLED customers.

• Own retention, adoption, and expansion outcomes for the Public Sector book, with accurate forecasting that accounts for fiscal year timing, funding cycles, and contract vehicles.

• Build and maintain executive relationships with agency and organization leaders, including CISOs, CIOs, and program and procurement stakeholders. Serve as a senior escalation point for critical customer issues.

• Partner with Public Sector Sales leadership to establish clear ownership and communication lanes after the close, so customers experience one coordinated Abnormal team.

• Work with Renewals, Channel, and resellers on compliant, predictable renewals and approved expansion motions such as true-ups and scope changes.

• Bring working knowledge of FedRAMP, GovRAMP or StateRAMP, and government procurement to how we onboard, support, and renew customers.

• Represent the public sector customer voice to Product and Engineering with prioritized, business-backed input rather than lists of requests.

• Champion AI-enabled workflows and data-driven health and risk management to free CSM capacity for high-impact customer work.

• Hire, onboard, and develop federal-ready Customer Success talent as the business grows.

• Travel as needed to meet customers and internal teams, up to 25% (confirm).

 Must Haves

• Significant experience serving U.S. Public Sector customers, with federal experience required and a demonstrated long-term commitment to the public sector (confirm minimum years).

• 10+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Post-Sales leadership in B2B SaaS, including 5+ years leading Customer Success teams (confirm).

• Established relationships with federal, state, local, or education organizations that bring credibility with customers and Sales.

• Working knowledge of government procurement, fiscal year budgeting, contract vehicles, and channel or reseller-led buying.

• Familiarity with public sector compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP and GovRAMP or StateRAMP.

• Proven track record of driving retention and expansion outcomes and forecasting renewals in long, budget-driven cycles.

• Experience partnering with a Sales organization that stays closely involved after the sale, and defining clear ownership as a result.

• Strong executive presence and the ability to engage senior government stakeholders.

• Experience building or operationalizing AI-driven processes in post-sales functions.

• Based in, or willing to relocate to, the Washington, DC area (confirm).

 Nice to Haves

• Experience in cybersecurity, email security, or enterprise infrastructure software.

• Active security clearance, or the ability to obtain one (confirm whether required).

• Experience with DoD, Intelligence Community, or large civilian federal agencies.

• Prior experience building or scaling a federal Customer Success function from a small base.

• Familiarity with Salesforce and Gainsight.

title: Data Strategy Operations Manager
description:
Headquarters: Remote - USA

 About the Role

 As the Data Strategy and Operations Manager at Abnormal AI, you will own our go-to-market data quality strategy and serve as the steward of data across Salesforce and the systems around it. You will design the processes, controls, and intelligent workflows that keep data accurate, enriched, and trusted at scale, so Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance can give executive leadership reliable metrics. You will decide where AI agents and automation take over repetitive data work and where human judgment still matters, and partner with cross-functional teams to evaluate system changes that affect our data programs.

 Who you are

• Data obsessed and just as obsessed with removing manual work, with a habit of automating any process that relies on fixing records by hand

• Curious about AI and a daily user, with experience shipping workflows with LLMs, agents, or AI-assisted tooling, and able to tell a useful application from a demo

• Eager to build and shape a program rather than only maintain one, and able to create systems that hold up at global scale

• Highly analytical, able to see the big picture and spot trends and gaps, then zoom in with practical, specific recommendations

• Steady when juggling multiple priorities in a constantly changing environment

• A good teammate, dedicated to the mission, who likes to have fun along the way

 What you will do

• Set the data governance strategy, standards, ownership model, and source-of-truth hierarchy for GTM data across Salesforce and connected systems

• Establish policies, access controls, and field-level definitions, including record creation and deprecation rules, and monitor adherence

• Ensure compliance and security of our data, and flag risks to IT, security, and leadership

• Replace high-volume manual tasks (deduplication, enrichment, account matching, hierarchy mapping, routing, anomaly review) with automated and AI-assisted workflows

• Design and maintain AI agents and LLM-powered workflows that classify, enrich, validate, and remediate data, with guardrails, human review points, and accuracy measurement

• Build automated data quality monitoring that detects issues early, alerts the right owner, and fixes them without human intervention where appropriate

• Evaluate and select AI, enrichment, and automation tooling, run pilots, and measure impact through time saved, accuracy gains, and coverage

• Own the enrichment strategy and keep account firmographics accurate: hierarchies, employee count, location, industry, and Fortune ranking

• Act as the subject matter expert for Business Ops, Marketing Ops, Customer Success, and Finance, run a defined feedback intake process, and support consistent reporting and dashboards

• Manage a portfolio of data quality and automation projects with clear priorities, owners, and outcomes

 Must Haves

• 5+ years in Sales Operations, Data Operations, or a similar analytical or systems role

• Hands-on experience building automation with AI or LLM tools (agents, prompt-driven workflows, AI-assisted enrichment), with shipped examples you can easily share

• Strong understanding of data lifecycle management, data modeling, master data management, and requirements gathering

• Demonstrated understanding of Salesforce automation, including Flow and validation rules, and experience working closely with admins

• Experience implementing and managing data and enrichment tools, including AI-native tools such as Clay, Kernel, Starbridge, and Onfire

• Proficiency in Excel

• Track record of leading data management projects from idea to result

• Sound judgment about where AI is reliable and where it needs controls for privacy, security, and accuracy

• Detail oriented, self-motivated, proactive, and quick to learn new tools

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical and AI concepts to non-technical partners

• Preferred: experience with workflow automation or integration platforms (such as Workato or Zapier), modern data stack tools (such as Snowflake or dbt), SQL, and a high-growth SaaS or security company

description:
Headquarters: Remote - LA; Remote - OK; Remote - TX

 Who we are

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 About the role:

 As a Sales Engineer (SE) at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of technically-minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet maintenance strategies, global asset management, machine control systems/diagnostics, system integration, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful SE at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US within the TOLA region (Texas, Oklahoma, Louisiana, Arkansas) within the US except Alaska, California (non-Bay Area), Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Denver Metro (CO), Boulder Metro (CO),Chicago Metro (IL), Austin Metro (TX), Houston Metro (TX), Dallas Metro (TX), Seattle Metro (WA), SF Bay Metros (CA), NYC Metro (NY) and Washington DC Metro. Relocation expenses will not be provided for this role.

 You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

• You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

 In this role, you will:

• Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.

• Demonstrate quick and efficient discovery to understand customer needs and answer any tech questions with the goal of doing so on a single call.

• Be highly available for standard demo/account coverage and temporary technical expertise across the entire Samsara Sales Team.

• Understand how our devices are installed (enough to explain to a prospect over the phone).

• Educate customers on technical aspects of APIs, and be able to deploy scripts leveraging the Samsara API to a testing environment on demand.

• Be an advocate for your AE's, prospects, and customers when it comes to internal tech conversations.

• Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s values and operating principles as we scale globally and across new offices

 An ideal candidate would:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline

• Preferred 1+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales or support capacity

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

• Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems

• Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, networking, automation and control systems

• Experience tinkering with hardware gadgets, sensors, or vehicles is a plus

title: Sr. Product Manager
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 Senior Product Manager, Audience & Discovery

 The Role

 As the Senior Product Manager, Audience & Discovery, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the capabilities that allow marketing and revenue teams to build and manage audiences, explore account and contact details, and take action across Activation channels. These capabilities support some of the core functionality of the 6sense Agentic GTM platform.

 This role covers the Audience & Discovery product area on the Activation team. You will build intuitive, scalable experiences for segment and list management, account and contact exploration, and handoff to Activation channels, in close partnership with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Success, and go-to-market teams. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Sr. Director - Product Management.

 Key Responsibilities

• Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and success metrics for Audience & Discovery product lines.

• Build workflows that help users create, organize, and act on audience segments and lists at scale; Design experiences that let users search, filter, and explore accounts and contacts, and understand the details and context behind each one.

• Enable action from every audience and record, with seamless, reliable handoff to Activation channels such as Advertising, Intelligent Workflows, AI Email, Sales Intelligence and Agents at scale.

• Define how agents, RevvyAI and APIs can create, retrieve, update, and act on audiences and account and contact data across the Agentic GTM platform.

• Translate customer needs into clear requirements, user journeys, acceptance criteria, and measurable outcomes.

• Partner cross-functionally to launch high-quality features, make tradeoffs using data and customer feedback, and improve usability, reliability, and scale.

• Define and track success metrics for adoption, audience creation and reuse, discovery engagement, activation rate, and business impact.

• Establish feedback loops with customers and internal teams to continuously improve audience quality and discovery effectiveness.

• Partner with internal teams to monitor product health, identify friction points, and improve performance, reliability, and scalability over time.

 Performance Metrics

• Adoption and active usage of audience management and discovery workflows.

• Growth in audience creation, reuse, and activation across channels.

• Discovery engagement, including time to find and act on the right accounts and contacts.

• Reliability and performance of audience segments, lists, and export experiences at scale.

• Customer impact, including satisfaction, retention, pipeline influence, and product differentiation.

 Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

• 6–8 years in product management, with experience in B2B SaaS, AI products, or sales and marketing technology.

• Strong technical fluency across data products, APIs, integrations, analytics, and AI-enabled and agentic experiences.

• Experience partnering with Engineering, Design, Data Science, Customer Success, Sales, and Product Marketing to deliver customer-facing products.

• Strong customer orientation, analytical judgment, and communication skills for technical and non-technical audiences.

 Key Competencies

• Strategic, customer-centered product thinker with strong ownership and judgment.

• Data-driven decision maker who can connect product usage, customer value, and business outcomes.

• Systems thinker who can operate in ambiguity and simplify complex customer workflows.

• Strong collaborator who can align cross-functional teams and drive execution from discovery to launch.

 Why You’ll Love This Role

• Impact. You will own the core experiences where marketing and sales teams decide who to target and take action on it, at the center of the Agentic GTM platform.

• Innovation. You’ll shape how audiences and discovery work in an agentic world, making it easier for users and agents alike to find the right accounts and act.

• Growth. Join a rocket ship, learn every day, and accelerate your career in a collaborative, high-energy environment.

• Fun. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. Expect GIFs, puns, and the occasional Agentic GTM meme.

Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience.  About 6sense

 Our mission. 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our people. People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 6sense is Intelligence for Agentic GTM. We turn every signal — yours and ours — into intelligence that every team, tool, and AI agent can act on and trust. Every day, the 6sense Signalverse™ captures one trillion signals to power AI that pinpoints who's ready to buy, how to engage them, and when to act. 6sense was named a Leader in The Forrester Wave™: Revenue Marketing Platforms for B2B, Q1 2026.

 THE ROLE IN ONE PARAGRAPH

 We're hiring a Sr. Data Scientist to show the impact our work has for customers. You'll measure how each engagement moves customers' pipeline and renewals, build the value analysis customers and leadership rely on, and work hands-on with the senior data scientists on customer models.

 This role sits where analytics meets modeling. It suits someone who wants to see the business outcome of their work and grow into a forward-deployed data scientist.

 What You'll Do

 Build for the customer

• Set a baseline for every engagement before work starts, then track the results: account health, renewal outcome, and how predictive scores perform for the customer's sales team.

• Measure how scored accounts perform against unscored ones: close rate, sales cycle length and deal size.

• Assess the impact of model and configuration changes on model performance, qualified-account volume and pipeline timing.

• Run before-and-after and holdout-style analyses that separate a change's real effect from noise.

• Work on live engagements with the senior data scientists: validate account lists, compare a customer's CRM fields with 6sense firmographic data, and help tailor and tune models.

 Productize for everyone

• Build value analysis Data Science can run for any customer on demand, such as qualified-account efficiency, deal journeys and conversion by score bucket.

• Build the dashboards and reporting the team, Customer Success and leadership use to follow engagement outcomes.

 What You'll Bring

• Required: 5+ years in data science or advanced analytics, with experience building models and measuring business outcomes.

• Strong SQL and Python, and experience turning messy data into analysis people trust, including matching records across systems by ID.

• Solid grounding in statistics and experiment design: baselines, control groups, and knowing when a difference is real.

• Experience building dashboards or reporting for business stakeholders.

• Clear communicator who can explain what the numbers mean, and what they don't.

• Comfortable switching between several projects at once.

• Nice to have: B2B go-to-market or SaaS customer data (CRM, renewals, pipeline, customer health); a customer-facing, consulting or analytics-for-clients role; BI tools such as Tableau; data platforms such as SingleStore, Snowflake or Hive.

 What Success Looks Like

• In 3 months: every active engagement has a documented baseline and an agreed success measure.

• In 6 months: leadership reviews engagement results from reporting you built, and you've contributed to at least one customer model.

• In 12 months: the team can show the business value of its work across all engagements, and you're leading data science work on engagements of your own.

 Why this role is different: you see the business outcome of the work directly, and you're the one who shows customers and leadership what it's worth. It's also a direct path into forward-deployed data science.

title: Associate Sales Engineer, SE Desk - Southeast
description:
Headquarters: Remote - FL; Remote - GA; Remote - NC; Remote - TN

 Who we are

 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 About the role:

 As a Sales Engineer (SE) at Samsara, you’d be part of a diverse group of technically-minded folks working together to bring our unique connected operations technology to customers. Our daily customer engagements include conversations around logistics/supply chain management, fleet maintenance strategies, global asset management, machine control systems/diagnostics, system integration, and regulatory compliance. This means a successful SE at Samsara will develop a thorough understanding of IoT hardware and sensors, hands-on installation/deployment scenarios, carrier networks, cloud infrastructure, and third-party system integrations (via our open API) to ensure the proper technical solution is presented to our customers.

 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the Southeast region within the US except Alaska, California (non-Bay Area), Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Rhode Island, Denver Metro (CO), Boulder Metro (CO),Chicago Metro (IL), Austin Metro (TX), Houston Metro (TX), Dallas Metro (TX), Seattle Metro (WA), SF Bay Metros (CA), NYC Metro (NY) and Washington DC Metro . Relocation expenses will not be provided for this role.

 You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.

• You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customer's value earned trust and human relationships built over time.

• You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

• You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focusing on winning as a team.

 In this role, you will:

• Become an expert on Samsara products: where the rubber of cutting-edge tech (IoT, AI, computer vision) meets the road of driving digital transformation for physical operations.

• Demonstrate quick and efficient discovery to understand customer needs and answer any tech questions with the goal of doing so on a single call.

• Be highly available for standard demo/account coverage and temporary technical expertise across the entire Samsara Sales Team.

• Understand how our devices are installed (enough to explain to a prospect over the phone).

• Educate customers on technical aspects of APIs, and be able to deploy scripts leveraging the Samsara API to a testing environment on demand.

• Be an advocate for your AE's, prospects, and customers when it comes to internal tech conversations.

• Act as a liaison between Samsara’s product and sales teams, translating technical feedback and enrolling the right customers in our beta programs.

• Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s values and operating principles as we scale globally and across new offices

 An ideal candidate would:

• BS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related discipline

• Preferred 1+ years experience working with customers in a pre-sales or support capacity

• Ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences

• Basic understanding of electronics and electrical systems

• Well-versed in one of the following: cloud software, networking, automation and control systems

• Experience tinkering with hardware gadgets, sensors, or vehicles is a plus

 The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

 The range of annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that OTE pay may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

 Annual OTE Salary
 $77,350 — $104,000 USD

 Total Rewards

 At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

 Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

 Flexible Working

 At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

 Belonging at Samsara

 At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

 Accommodations

 Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

 Our Commitment to Authenticity

 We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

 Fraudulent Employment Offers

 Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here .

title: Creative Engineer, Stripe Creative Lab
description:
Headquarters: New York, US, Canada, Remote

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

 Brand Studio team works on a variety of brand-centric projects for Stripe, from our brand standards to campaigns, events, IRL experiences, packaging, digital products, and even printed publications. The brand designers on this team are multidisciplinary in nature, able to design robust visual systems, art direction, and craft surfaces that focus on brand and product storytelling.

 Collaborating with other teams at Stripe, as well as external partners, we raise the quality and consistency of experiences with the Stripe brand IRL, virtually, and everywhere in between. We craft the creative vision and strategy for different types of projects and audiences, and amplify them across various mediums, channels, objects to environments, and digital and physical experiences.

 About Stripe Creative Lab

 Stripe Creative Lab aims to create breakthrough, culturally resonant, and exquisitely crafted projects that reveal Stripe’s magic in surprising ways. We dedicate ourselves to meticulously crafting the work to ensure the highest possible creative quality. The work is experimental, often starts with ambiguous briefs and requires finding a way where others might deem it impossible. We are making it up as we go, and that’s the way we love to work.

 What you’ll do

 You’ll be joining a highly creative team working across digital experiences, interactive projects, physical installations, experimental technology, and whatever else an idea might require. The work often begins without an obvious technical solution and sometimes without knowing exactly what form the final project should take.

 As a Design Engineer, you’ll work closely with designers, art directors, and producers to figure out what’s possible, prototype ideas quickly, and turn ambitious creative concepts into working experiences. You’ll bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, alongside the curiosity and technical range to work confidently beyond it.

 A significant amount of our work lives on the internet, so you should be comfortable independently building and shipping highly crafted digital experiences. Other projects may involve hardware, physical computing, unusual displays, installations, or technical systems we haven’t encountered before. You won’t be expected to be an expert in everything, but you should be excited to learn, experiment, and know when to bring in specialists.

 Responsibilities

• Prototype and build highly crafted, experimental digital experiences, interactive projects, and creative tools

• Work closely with designers and art directors to translate ambitious creative direction into technically excellent experiences, while contributing your own judgment to make the work better

• Explore emerging technologies and unfamiliar technical approaches, quickly determining what is possible and how best to build it

• Independently navigate ambiguous technical problems, moving pragmatically from early experiments to finished work

• Build and publish standalone web experiences when appropriate, while identifying and communicating the additional engineering support required for more complex projects

• Experiment with hardware, physical computing, displays, sensors, embedded systems, and other technologies when projects call for them

• Collaborate with external engineers, fabricators, technical studios, and other specialists, contributing enough technical fluency to be an effective creative and engineering partner

• Maintain a high bar for performance, reliability, usability, and craft without allowing conventional technical approaches to unnecessarily constrain an idea

 Who you are

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 6+ years of relevant software engineering, creative technology, or creative development experience

• Deep expertise in at least one area of creative engineering, with demonstrated curiosity and competence across adjacent technologies

• A portfolio of technically ambitious, highly crafted work such as experimental websites, interactive experiences, realtime graphics, games, installations, creative tools, or other unusual applications of technology

• Strong frontend engineering fundamentals and experience independently building and shipping public-facing web experiences

• Strong visual and interaction sensibility, with the ability to faithfully execute sophisticated creative direction and identify opportunities to improve it

• Experience solving unfamiliar technical problems with a high degree of independence

• Experience writing thoughtful, maintainable code and making pragmatic engineering decisions in fast-moving environments

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience with realtime graphics, WebGL, WebGPU, Three.js, shaders, animation, generative systems, or other forms of creative coding

• Experience working with hardware, physical computing, embedded systems, sensors, displays, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, or interactive installations

• Familiarity with backend development, APIs, networking, cloud infrastructure, or other areas beyond frontend engineering

• Experience collaborating with designers, artists, fabricators, creative studios, or other multidisciplinary partners

• Experience identifying, evaluating, and directing outside technical specialists when a project extends beyond your own expertise

• Deep curiosity about technology, design, craft, and the ways new technical capabilities can enable new forms of creative work

title: Sales Development - UK/I
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

Our Sales Development team play a crucial role in building an effective outbound sales strategy, whilst working closely with the Account Executives.

We don’t just sell a product or custom-level solutions; we are partnering with enterprises to help them generate new experiences and monetisation opportunities at scale with our breakthrough voice technology.

In this role you will:

  • Conduct research to identify potential leads and prospects within the target market

  • Engage in outbound activities such as cold calling, emailing, and social media outreach to initiate contact with potential customers

  • Implement personalized and effective outreach campaigns to maximize lead conversion.

  • Collaborate closely with the Account Executive to exchange insights on prospect feedback, objections, and market trends

  • Continuously refine and adjust outreach strategies based on the feedback loop

  • Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) related to outbound sales activities, including conversion rates, lead quality, and outreach effectiveness

  • Collaborate with the sales leadership to analyze data and optimize strategies for better results

Requirements

  • 2–3+ years of outbound B2B sales experience, with a strong track record of securing net-new business meetings

  • Proven ability to build and qualify opportunity-sized lead lists in new markets and verticals

  • Fluency with modern prospecting tools and multi-channel outreach strategies

  • Experience building and scaling outbound processes in fast-paced environments

  • Intellectually curious, asking thoughtful questions and developing insights-driven approaches to outreach

  • Highly self-motivated, able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team culture

  • Strong prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to handle a high volume of leads efficiently

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Fluency in additional European languages is desirable but not essential

Location

This role is remote-first, however there is a preference for candidates to be based in London or Dublin with the option to work out of one of our offices.

title: Lead Growth Analyst
description:
Fully Remote (UK based) | Competitive Salary + Bonus + Generous Equity | B Corp Certified

TrustedHousesitters is a fast growing, direct-to-consumer marketplace that is redefining pet care and travel.

Here at TrustedHousesitters, we’re on a mission to make travel work better for pets, for their people, and for the global community of animal lovers who look after them. We’ve got big plans on becoming the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people. We’ve built something pretty special: a trusted place where pet owners and sitters connect to keep pets happy at home while their humans explore the world.

We’ve already grown into a global community with members in over 140 countries, a product people genuinely love, and a team of more than 100 brilliant humans powering it all.

But we’re only just getting started. Our goal? To grow to 1 million members and make TrustedHousesitters the world’s most-loved travel solution for pet people.

At the moment, a sit starts every two minutes somewhere on the planet. We want that to be every single minute and we know the only way we’ll get there is with the right people in the right roles.

The right people in the right roles will shape our future. So, here’s the big question: Could that be you?

We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded Lead Growth Analyst to join our Marketing Analytics team. Our aim is to help the business understand what is driving growth, where performance is changing, and where the biggest opportunities and risks are.

In this role, you will lead analysis on some of our most important growth questions. You will take ownership of analytical workstreams end to end, from framing the business question and exploring the data through to clear recommendations and supporting execution.

A key part of the role will be helping teams make better growth and investment decisions. You will bring together signals from channel performance, customer behaviour and experimentation to understand what is driving performance.

You will partner closely with Growth, Marketing and Product teams, acting as a trusted thought partner.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end analysis on priority growth questions, from problem definition through to recommendation and measurement.

  • Proactively identify and investigate changes in growth performance, including the key drivers, risks and opportunities behind them, rather than waiting for questions to be handed over.

    Identify and size growth opportunities across channels, customer journeys and Product.

  • Support investment decisions by bringing together MMM, channel performance and customer behaviour.

  • Build clear growth narratives from complex analysis, translating data into concise, understandable insights with a strong “so what”, and clearly articulating the implications and actions for stakeholders.

  • Contribute to wider commercial questions such as forecasting, pricing and scenario analysis where they materially affect growth.

  • Build scalable analytical approaches that improve the speed, consistency and quality of decision-making.

  • Act as a trusted analytical partner, bringing a clear analytical point of view that shapes key growth decisions.

  • Own key stakeholder relationships and help ensure analytical recommendations are followed through into action and measurable impact.

  • Mentor other analysts and help raise the analytical bar across the team.

Experience and competencies

  • Significant experience in growth, marketing, or commercial analytics within a digital, marketplace, subscription or consumer technology business.
  • Strong understanding of growth, customer acquisition, funnel performance and the interaction between Marketing and Product.
  • Experience analysing customer journeys across multiple stages of the funnel, including cohort behaviour, lifecycle performance and longer conversion or nurturing journeys.
  • Good knowledge of marketing effectiveness approaches such as MMM, incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution.
  • Proven ability to independently structure and lead complex or ambiguous analytical work.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to move from analysis to clear recommendations.
  • Comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, influencing without authority and partnering closely with leadership teams.
    Flexible and open-minded, able to thrive in a fast-moving, evolving environment.
  • Clear, confident communicator with strong written and verbal presentation skills.

Tools and technical skills

  • Advanced SQL. You're not reaching for documentation for standard analytical patterns
  • Familiarity with analytical tools and languages such as Python or R.
  • Experience working with marketing and experimentation data from major digital platforms and internal data warehouses (we use Databricks).
  • Practical understanding of advanced measurement methodologies and their limitations in real-world decision-making.
  • Nice to have: experience integrating AI tools into analytical workflows in a way that's actually made a difference

Compensation

Additional Information

In addition to a competitive salary and bonus, we offer a range of benefits, including:

🐾 For the love of pets

  • Each year, you’ll get a Premium TrustedHousesitters Combined membership which includes benefits like free airport lounge passes, Sit Cancellation Plan and Home and Contents Plan, plus five Premium memberships to gift to friends and family
  • Our team can work remotely from as many house sits as they like, and we contribute up to £500 per
    year towards travel costs to and from sits
  • Find a rescue pet to join your family and we’ll cover the adoption fees, as well as “pawternity” to help your pet settle into their new home

💜 Health & wellbeing

  • SimplyHealth healthcare cash plan
  • Bupa Health Insurance and Dental Insurance plan
  • Specsavers eyecare scheme
  • Weekly virtual yoga sessions
  • Optional enrollment onto our Trusted Giving scheme, which includes employee giving via Charities Trust and 2 days paid annual volunteering allowance

💻 Working environment

  • Work fully remotely from anywhere in the world - as long as you follow compliance as a UK tax resident
  • Get £200 to spend on home office equipment each year + Macbook and Apple accessories when you start
  • Access to Spaces co-working locations across the globe
  • We host an all-expenses-paid meetup each quarter and fund team events (remote or in-person) throughout the year
  • We cover the costs of personal development resources and have regular time set aside for learning and growth
  • Depending on your role within the business, you’ll have the option to customise your work hours to better align with your personal schedule

💰 Compensation & time off

  • 25 days off per year, plus bank holidays and festive closure between Christmas and New Year (36 days + Christmas Day for some roles)
  • Competitive salary which is reviewed annually
  • Generous equity package for permanent employees
  • Discretionary 10% quarterly bonus scheme, distributed quarterly
  • Pension scheme: 5% from you as an employee and 3% from TrustedHousesitters

Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
