title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description:
Headquarters: Remote - United Kingdom

 REQ ID: FEQ227R147

 Location: United Kingdom (Remote/Hybrid — London or UK-based)

 Recruiter: Dina Hussain

 About the Role

 We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

 You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

 This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

 What You'll Do

• Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.

• Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.

• Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.

• Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.

• Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.

• Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.

• Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

 What We're Looking For

• Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.

• Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.

• Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).

• Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.

• Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

• Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.

• A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.

• Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.

• Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.

• Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

 Nice to Have

• Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.

• Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.

• Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

 Why This Role

 You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.
 About Databricks

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

 Benefits

 At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

 Compliance

 If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

We bring Stripe’s operating principles to life through thoughtful, consistent hiring practices, a high-quality candidate experience, and data-informed partnership with the business.

 What you’ll do

 Stripe is looking for a consultative, creative recruiter to support critical Core Business functions. You will partner with senior leaders who shape Stripe’s financial strategy, external narrative, long-term growth, and company-wide decision-making.

 This is a high-impact portfolio with varied talent markets, senior stakeholders, and roles where the quality of each hire can influence how Stripe operates and grows.  This is a 12 month fixed term contract and you are employed directly through Stripe.

 Responsibilities

• Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities, define hiring plans, and develop recruiting strategies that support headcount goals.

 Who you are

 Minimum requirements

• 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including in-house recruiting experience.

• Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, talent-market insights, and complex searches.

• Ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and influence decisions through sound judgment, data, and market knowledge.

• Experience developing sourcing strategies and engaging candidates for specialized or senior roles.

• Ability to use recruiting data to identify trends, communicate progress, and improve recruiting outcomes.

• Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple searches and shifting priorities.

• A collaborative approach and comfort working across functions to solve problems and improve the hiring experience.

• Curiosity about emerging AI tools and a practical approach to testing and adopting new ways of working.

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience recruiting for business, corporate, finance, communications, strategy, legal, or other specialized professional functions.

• Experience supporting senior-level hiring or roles with complex stakeholder groups.

• Experience working across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy.

• Familiarity with recruiting systems and sourcing tools, including applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management tools, and LinkedIn Recruiter.

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.  About the team

 The Risk team helps maintain a healthy financial ecosystem for businesses around the world. Credit Operations conducts credit risk assessments, underwrites small and mid-sized users, and develops mitigation strategies that enable Stripe to take smart risks while supporting growth. The globally distributed team partners with stakeholders across regions to support new and existing users and products.

 What you’ll do

 As a Credit Operations Manager, you will lead and develop a team of credit operations analysts while setting a strategic vision for scalable, high-quality operations. You will help enable new and existing Stripe products by translating product strategies into operational capabilities and appropriate credit controls. In partnership with Credit Strategy, Product, Engineering, and Data Science, you will launch new programs and advance AI-enabled automation across Credit Operations.

 Responsibilities

• Lead, motivate, and develop a high-performing Credit Operations team by setting clear goals, providing regular coaching and feedback, and supporting professional growth

• Assess the team’s current and future capability needs and partner on hiring, workforce planning, and development strategies to close material gaps

• Set priorities for the team in alignment with Credit’s broader strategy and translate them into clear goals, work plans, and operating mechanisms

• Evolve Credit Operations’ systems, processes, and operating model to improve decision quality, mitigate emerging risks, and scale efficiently

• Support new and existing Stripe products by assessing credit and operational impacts, defining requirements and controls, and preparing Credit Operations for launch and ongoing support

• Partner with Risk leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize investments in risk mitigation, operational efficiency, and user experience

• Use AI-enabled tools and partner with technical and operational stakeholders to test and implement automation, with appropriate quality controls and change management

• Define and manage operating metrics and service-level agreements, using performance insights and root-cause analysis to drive improvements

 Who you are

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements

• 10-15 years of work experience in commercial credit underwriting

• 3-5 years of experience leading credit risk or underwriting teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment

• Experience in financial risk modeling or cash-flow forecasting

• Proven track record of building, leading, and developing high-performing teams, including setting goals, managing performance, and coaching team members

• Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex challenges into actionable solutions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence across functions

• Demonstrated experience designing, launching, and scaling programs, products, or operational capabilities from planning through implementation and measurement

• Experience using AI-enabled tools and partnering with technical and operational stakeholders to implement automation, including quality controls, change management, and team adoption

• Commitment to delivering a user-centered experience while effectively managing risk

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting credit-related product launches or translating product capabilities into operational requirements, workflows, controls, and launch-readiness plans

• Strong knowledge of accounting principles and experience evaluating financial statements and business models across industries

• Experience analyzing data and creating dashboards using SQL

• Experience partnering with engineering teams to develop or improve investigative and decisioning tools

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or certification is a plus

title: Incident Escalations Manager
description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As a Ping Incident Escalations Manager, you will provide Level 2 incident response and escalation support within the Cyber Security Engineering team. You will help coordinate complex security incidents, improve incident readiness, and ensure that lessons learned are converted into practical improvements.

This is an individual contributor role, combining technical incident response experience with strong operational coordination. You will work closely with CSE engineers and cross-functional teams to maintain momentum during incidents, support tabletop exercises, and improve our incident response capability.

You will

  • Act as a Level 2 escalation point for CSE engineers during complex or high-risk security incidents
  • Coordinate incident response across Cyber Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, IT, Product, and other relevant teams
  • Establish incident priorities, ownership, actions, dependencies, and communication cadence
  • Support investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and validation activities
  • Maintain accurate incident timelines, decision records, action logs, and stakeholder updates
  • Prepare and support cyber security tabletop exercises, including scenarios, injects, facilitation, and follow-up actions
  • Develop and improve incident response playbooks, runbooks, escalation paths, and readiness procedures
  • Lead or support post-incident reviews and ensure lessons learned are converted into tracked improvements
  • Identify recurring response gaps, operational risks, and opportunities for automation or process improvement
  • Participate in the Cyber Security Engineering on-call or escalation rota, where required
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve incident response readiness and security outcomes

Requirements

  • Experience in cyber security engineering, incident response, security operations, SRE, or technical operations
  • Experience responding to or coordinating security incidents involving multiple teams
  • Strong operational judgement and the ability to make decisions under pressure and with incomplete information
  • Experience acting as an incident lead, technical lead, escalation point, or senior responder
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical risk clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience creating or improving incident response playbooks, runbooks, procedures, or post-incident reviews
  • Experience conducting, facilitating, or supporting tabletop or operational readiness exercises
  • Ability to influence and coordinate teams without direct reporting authority
  • Experience with security investigation and response tooling, such as SIEM, EDR, cloud logging, identity telemetry, or security orchestration platforms
  • Strong understanding of cloud environments, preferably AWS and/or GCP
  • Understanding of enterprise and SaaS operational environments
  • On-call and escalation participation is a requirement for this position

You have an advantage if:

  • Experience with Google SecOps and YARA-L
  • Experience with security orchestration, automation, and bespoke scripting
  • Experience working with Kubernetes and Docker in development or incident response contexts
  • Experience with threat intelligence, detection engineering, EDR, identity response, or cloud forensics
  • Experience improving incident response maturity, operational metrics, or security operating procedures

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £68,000 to £78,000 base plus bonus and equity

What You'll Do:

You are the person who brings Huntress to life in the room. You travel to roadshows, tradeshows, and other events, meet people who didn't plan to meet you, and turn genuine conversations into momentum for the business. Give More Than We Take shows up in the way you create value first, listen closely, and build relationships that feel human rather than transactional.

  • Experience engaging prospects at tradeshows, roadshows, conferences, or other in-person events is valuable.
  • You are curious, self-starting, eager to learn, driven, and comfortable taking initiative without waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You can engage strangers naturally, make small talk that leads somewhere useful, and build relationships without making the interaction feel transactional.
  • You are travel-ready and comfortable working in environments that require frequent movement, quick judgment, and consistent energy.
  • You are detail-oriented and able to follow a process while recognizing when the situation calls for a thoughtful deviation.
  • You use AI to work faster and smarter in day-to-day preparation, research, and follow-up, with good judgment about accuracy, privacy, and when human context matters most.

description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

 Sr. Director, Client Service (FIT)

 Location: New York, USA

 Bounteous is a premier end-to-end digital transformation consultancy dedicated to partnering with ambitious brands to create digital solutions for todayâs complex challenges and tomorrowâs opportunities. With uncompromising standards for technical and domain expertise, we deliver innovative and strategic solutions in Strategy, Analytics, Digital Engineering, Cloud, Data & AI, Experience Design, and Marketing.

 Our Co-Innovation methodology is a unique engagement model designed to align interests and accelerate value creation. Our clients worldwide benefit from the skills and expertise of over 5,000+ expert team members across the Americas, APAC, and EMEA. By partnering with leading technology providers, we craft transformative digital experiences that enhance customer engagement and drive business success.

 We are seeking a Senior Director, Client Service, based in New York, to join our growing Financial Services (FIT) Business Unit. This role is responsible for building and expanding strategic relationships with enterprise financial services clients, driving account growth, developing new opportunities within existing accounts, and ensuring exceptional client satisfaction.

 The ideal candidate brings strong financial services industry knowledge, a proven track record of commercial account ownership within technology consulting or digital transformation services, and the ability to build relationships with senior business and technology executives. Experience driving growth across digital engineering, cloud, data, AI, and enterprise transformation initiatives is highly valued.

 Role and Responsibilities

•
 Oversee and grow a portfolio of strategic financial services client accounts, comprising $5MM+ in annual revenue.

•
 Develop and maintain strong relationships with executive leaders and senior business and technology stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and other key decision-makers.

•
 Drive organic account growth by identifying, developing, and expanding opportunities within existing financial services clients.

•
 Partner with clients and internal teams to design and deliver innovative digital transformation, engineering, cloud, data, and AI solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

•
 Develop and execute strategic account plans focused on revenue growth, relationship expansion, client retention, and long-term partnership development.

•
 Identify opportunities to expand Bounteous' services across client organizations, including digital engineering, cloud modernization, data platforms, AI, customer experience, and marketing technology.

•
 Build and manage a qualified pipeline of account expansion opportunities, partnering with solutioning, engineering, and delivery teams to develop proposals and secure new business.

•
 Collaborate with practice and competency leaders to deliver integrated solutions across strategy, data, experience, and engineering.

•
 Guide cross-functional teams from solution design through delivery and optimization, ensuring alignment with client objectives and business outcomes.

•
 Navigate complex client organizations, influence executive decision-making, and participate in key planning and strategic initiatives.

•
 Understand and address client priorities, business challenges, and concerns while maintaining strong client satisfaction and retention.

•
 Oversee Statement of Work development, contract negotiations, renewals, and account expansion in partnership with finance, legal, delivery, and engineering teams.

•
 Partner closely with Program Delivery teams to ensure successful execution, client satisfaction, and alignment with contractual commitments, budgets, and strategic outcomes.

•
 Maintain accurate account revenue forecasts, sales pipeline visibility, and growth projections within Salesforce.

•
 Stay informed on financial services industry trends, emerging technologies, and evolving client needs to proactively identify opportunities for innovation and account growth.

 10+ years of experience in technology consulting, digital transformation, client services, or strategic account leadership, with significant experience supporting financial services clients.

 Demonstrated success managing and growing enterprise financial services accounts with direct commercial ownership, revenue accountability, and account expansion responsibilities.

 Strong understanding of the financial services industry, including banking, payments, insurance, capital markets, or fintech.

•

 Experience collaborating with delivery, engineering, and solutioning teams to successfully execute complex client engagements.

•
 Strong executive presence, business acumen, communication, and negotiation skills.

•
 Experience operating within a matrixed consulting or technology services organization.

•
 BA/BS degree or equivalent relevant professional experience preferred.

title: GTM AI Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote - US

 About the Job:

 LaunchDarkly helps engineering teams ship software faster and more safely through feature management, experimentation, and AI delivery tooling. As a GTM AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operate the AI-powered systems that make our sales, marketing, customer success, and partnerships teams more effective.

 You will sit at the intersection of engineering and revenue. You’ll turn messy go-to-market workflows into reliable, measurable automation, such as agents that research accounts, tools that surface buying signals, and pipelines that keep our data trustworthy. You’ll work directly with GTM stakeholders to find high-leverage problems, ship quickly, and prove impact with data.

 Responsibilities:

• Design and build LLM-powered agents and workflows for use cases like account research, lead and account prioritization, outbound personalization, call summarization, deal inspection, renewal risk detection, and customer health insights.

• Focus on end user experience to optimize delivery of content, process adherence and tool utilization

• Integrate AI systems with the GTM stack (Salesforce, Outreach, Gong, Marketo, Slack, Zoom, data warehouse, and enrichment providers).

• Build and maintain data pipelines that unify product usage, CRM, marketing, and support data into reliable inputs for models and agents.

• Partner with Sales, Marketing, CS, and RevOps leaders to translate business problems into technical solutions, and prioritize by revenue impact and effort.

• Establish evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for AI outputs, covering accuracy, hallucination rates, cost, latency, and adoption.

• Use LaunchDarkly’s own products, such as feature flags, AI Configs, and experimentation, to roll out, test, and iterate on GTM AI systems safely.

• Prototype quickly, then productionize the winners with solid engineering practices (testing, observability, documentation, access controls).

• Enable GTM teams through training, documentation, and playbooks so AI tools are adopted and trusted.

• Stay current on the AI tooling landscape and recommend build vs. buy decisions.

 Qualifications:

• 4+ years of software engineering, data engineering, or ML/AI engineering experience (or equivalent hands-on experience)

• Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript, plus SQL

• Hands-on experience building applications with LLMs (prompt design, tool use/function calling, RAG, agent frameworks, structured outputs)

• Experience integrating with REST/GraphQL APIs and SaaS platforms, ideally CRM and sales engagement tools

• Familiarity with data warehouses and transformation tools (Snowflake, BigQuery, dbt, or similar)

• Ability to evaluate and monitor AI system quality using test sets, human review, and automated evals

• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders

• A bias toward shipping, iterating, and measuring outcomes

 Pay:

 Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 4:

• Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $196,600 - $270,270 **

• Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $176,900 - $243,210 **

 LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

 *Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
 **Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

 About LaunchDarkly:

 Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

 The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

• Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages

• Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts

• Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize

• Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types

• Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

 At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. LD invites any applicant to review our written Affirmative Action Plan. To do so, contact People Ops at hr@launchdarkly.com .

 Do you need a disability accommodation?

 Fill out this accommodations request form and someone from our People Operations team will contact you for assistance.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, LaunchDarkly recruiters will only contact you from @LaunchDarkly .com email addresses or via LinkedIn from "Verified Recruiter" accounts. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate LaunchDarkly recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before making a job offer. LaunchDarkly will never make a job offer without conducting a formal interview process. Our interview process does not involve asking detailed questions by email. If you are ever unsure about a communication that you receive, don't click any links—visit Careers | LaunchDarkly directly for confirmed job openings and links to apply.

 Please notify us of any fraudulent representation by sending an email to careers@launchdarkly.com .

title: Lakebase Sales Specialist, Nordics
description:
Headquarters: Remote - Denmark

 SLSQ327R349

 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Sales Specialist to help customers modernise their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase , our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications . This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with regional Account Executives to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications , helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

 The impact you will have:

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas, including platform teams and developers , data teams , and central IT, articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications , positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences

• Run complex sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references

• Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs

• Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organisation

 What success looks like in this role:

 This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase

• Drive longer-term Postgres standardisation and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts

 Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership: Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Strategic account engagement: Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

• Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.

• Market voice and thought leadership: Develop an internal and external presence, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

 The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

 What we look for:

• Relevant enterprise sales experience , consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals

• Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures , including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners)

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions , working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures , lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences

• Bachelor’s degree

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services , ideally within large or strategic accounts

• Familiarity with data platforms, lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies

• Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications

• Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services

• Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment , helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives

• Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions

 This description is intended to outline the core responsibilities and qualifications for the Lakebase Sales Specialist role. Actual responsibilities may evolve as the Lakebase product and go-to-market motions continue to grow and mature.

 About Databricks

 Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

 Benefits

 At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Strategic Sales Director, EMEA
description:
Cresta unlocks the true potential of the customer experience, turning every conversation into a competitive advantage. Cresta’s unified AI platform combines conversational AI agents, real-time human agent augmentation, and comprehensive conversation intelligence to drive revenue and efficiency gains across every channel. The world’s leading companies, including United Airlines, Cox Communications, and Marriott, use Cresta to power world-class customer experiences every day.

Born from the Stanford AI Lab, Cresta has raised more than $270 million from the world’s leading investors, including a16z, Greylock, and Sequoia. Cresta’s leadership includes some of the leading minds in AI today. Our CEO, Ping Wu, founded and led Google's Contact Center AI and Vertex AI platforms before joining Cresta to build the future of AI-driven customer experiences.

Over the next few years, AI is going to redefine how people all over the world interact with businesses every day. Come build that future at Cresta.

About the role:

As a founding Strategic Sales Director you will focus on some of the largest companies in EMEA, working on big strategic deals that will change the trajectory of the company. You’ll identify and articulate how Cresta can unlock significant value for our customers, build relationships with key executives and evangelize cutting edge AI technology. As an early member of the team at a growing startup, you’ll have the opportunity to help define our sales process, participate in regional expansion strategy and help build the EMEA region, starting with success in the UK.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about using cutting-edge AI to solve real-world business challenges. You'll help shape our sales strategy, influence cross-functional priorities, and contribute to building a high-performing, customer-obsessed sales culture.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the sales experience while building and managing relationships with key decision-makers and executives
  • Run complex sales cycles from initial contact to close
  • Prospect for new clients, design product presentations and business cases, develop and deliver proposals, negotiate and close contracts
  • Develop a command of the Cresta product, the Contact Center market, our unique competitive differentiators, and our customers’ needs
  • Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and Engineering to deliver an exceptional customer experience
  • Own and hit your number

Qualifications We Value:

  • 7+ years of SaaS software sales experience at an enterprise level, with referenceability of consistently delivering to sales quotas in this time
  • Experience negotiating, structuring and executing complex enterprise-level agreements
  • Prior experience leading cross-functional teams through large deal close processes
  • Ability to articulate contractual, technical, and financial value points to customers, including C-level executives
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills with experience presenting to C-level executives
  • Ability to be in London easily, often at short notice. Also, the ability to travel domestically and internationally up to around 25% of the time

Perks & Benefits:

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with plans to fit you and your family
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents welcoming a new child
  • Remote work setup budget to help you create a productive home office
  • Monthly wellness and communication stipend to keep you connected and balanced
  • 20 days of vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend

Compensation at Cresta

Cresta’s approach to compensation is simple: recognize impact, reward excellence, and invest in our people. We offer competitive, location-based pay that reflects the market and what each individual brings to the table.

The posted base salary range represents what we expect to pay for this role in a given location. Final offers are shaped by factors like experience, skills, education, and geography. In addition to base pay, total compensation includes equity and a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family.

This role is variable target compensation eligible. There is potential to exceed target earnings when goals are surpassed.

OTE Range: $215,000 – $230,000 Pound Sterling + Offers Equity

Our use of AI in recruiting: We may use AI tools in our recruiting process, which require human review and oversight. If you have questions about our use of AI or wish to opt out, please contact recruiting@cresta.ai (if you are opting out, please use the subject ‘Opt-Out’ in your email).

Recording & AI transcription: We do not authorize candidates to record or use AI transcription of any interview by phone, notetaker app, AI glasses, or other device. Candidates may request an exception or accommodation for review during the interview process as needed.

Recruiting impersonation scams: We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Cresta recruiting email communications will always come from the @cresta.ai domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Cresta via other sources should be ignored.

title: VP of Communications
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

The VP of Communications owns how TRM shows up in the world: the corporate narrative, the earned channels that carry it, and the voices across the company that amplify it. Criminals are scaling with AI, and TRM is building to own the AI investigations category. You'll build a dedicated communications function from responsibilities currently shared across the team, set proactive narrative strategy on how modern crime is changing and how it's best fought, so that the market, media, analysts, prospective talent, and investors look to TRM for the definitive view on how AI is changing crime, the capacity gap facing the people who fight it, and how crimefighters close it.

The impact you will have:

  • TRM is known as the company that owns the AI investigations category: one clear corporate narrative, carried consistently by our leaders in the conversations that matter, through an executive-visibility program you design and run

  • TRM's share of voice and quality of coverage grow across media, industry analysts, and our other earned channels, shaping how customers, prospective talent, and investors see the company, built on journalist and analyst relationships you own

  • Subject-matter experts from every function become recognized voices in their fields, carrying TRM's story on stages, in bylines, and across our corporate social channels, because you found them, placed them, prepared them, and gave them the guides and AI-enabled workflows to stay consistent and on-brand

  • TRM responds fast and credibly when reputation is on the line, because the monitoring, playbooks, and AI-assisted media tracking you put in place are ready before they're needed

What we're looking for:

  • 10+ years in corporate and executive communications, including owning earned media, ideally at a security, fintech, intelligence, or regulated-tech company

  • A proactive narrative strategist who has placed high-quality coverage and grown share of voice, not just shipped releases

  • Fluency in building sophisticated, credible corporate narratives about AI: what it changes, where it creates risk, and where your company stands, beyond using AI tools day to day

  • An AI-native approach: you use AI across monitoring, research, drafting, and reporting, and you build workflows others can use

  • A natural teacher and talent-spotter who can find the experts across a company, place them in the right forums, and coach them to be confident in front of press and audiences

  • Comfort building a function and its systems from the ground up, and leading cross-functionally without a large standing team

  • Exposure to a strong crisis-communications program and sound judgment under pressure; you've supported a live issue or two, but your instinct is to put TRM into the conversation, not keep it out

  • An excellent writer and editor who can distill complex, technical topics for press, executives, and the public

About the Team:

  • Reports to the Chief Brand Officer, within Brand & Communications

  • A senior leadership role that consolidates communications responsibilities currently split across several people into one dedicated function

  • Works closely with Policy, Insights, Product Marketing, Brand/Content, company Leadership, and subject-matter experts across the company

  • Manages TRM's PR agency and an APAC-based communications lead (contractor) from day one, with potential to build out a team as the function grows

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • US-based role; you'll build coverage for other time zones through your team and partners, starting with an APAC-based communications lead

  • Weekly marketing and leadership syncs; fast, async-first collaboration with executives and cross-functional partners

  • Clear communication norms and shared message guides so the company stays on-brand

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core overlap across US business hours

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call. Crisis-response availability is expected as issues arise.

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional travel for media, executive events, and team offsites

  • Frequency: Low to moderate (HM to confirm)

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Distributed; periodic in-person for key moments (HM to confirm)

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within 30 days: ship a corporate narrative and messaging architecture, and a plan to consolidate the split comms responsibilities into one function

  • Within 60 days: land a planned earned-media moment, stand up the executive-visibility calendar, and identify the first group of subject-matter experts to develop as thought leaders

  • Within 90 days: have a tested crisis-communications playbook in place and a repeatable, AI-assisted media-monitoring and reporting workflow running

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

  • Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only.

  • The estimated base salary range for this role is $195,000-$255,000

  • Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

  • Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to m

This position is needed to lead and execute the regional field marketing and high-touch event strategy across the UK & Nordics, accelerating pipeline conversion and driving measurable revenue growth across key target accounts.

As Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will serve as the field marketing engine for Twilio’s North region. Working closely with Sales Leadership, you will design and deliver targeted 1st-party events, C-level dinners, technical workshops, and partner co-marketing activations. You will engage key decision-makers, open doors in strategic accounts, and accelerate deal velocity across core products like WhatsApp for Business, Voice AI, and Conversations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you'll:

  • Partner closely with North Sales Leadership and Account Executives to align event programs directly with regional revenue targets and priority accounts across Strategic and New Business segments.
  • Design hyper-focused event experiences (e.g., C-level roundtables, founder dinners, technical deep-dive workshops, and roadshows) built to solve specific regional customer pain points.
  • Lead end-to-end strategy, content localisation, speaker sourcing, venue management, and execution for proprietary Twilio regional events across key North tech hubs (e.g., London, Stockholm, Copenhagen).
  • Own regional presence at strategic industry conferences and hyper-scaler co-marketing events (AWS, Meta, Google) in partnership with the Partner Marketing Manager.
  • Establish strict lead and attendee follow-up SLAs with regional SDR and AE teams to convert event engagement into qualified pipeline and deal velocity.
  • Develop targeted post-event content and micro-campaigns to enable Account Executives to maintain momentum with enterprise account teams.
  • Measure and report on event success through commercial metrics: target account penetration rate, pipeline created/influenced, deal velocity, and closed-won revenue.
  • Manage the apportioned regional field marketing budget and local vendor relationships to ensure optimal ROI and flawless execution.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 5–7 years of enterprise software/SaaS field marketing experience, with a proven track record of owning event strategy and execution tied directly to pipeline and revenue generation.
  • Deep familiarity with the UK & Nordics region, including regional business etiquette, key enterprise tech hubs, local event ecosystems, and localized content preferences.
  • Impeccable English written and verbal communication skills to write compelling local messaging and engage with regional enterprise buyers and agencies.
  • Demonstrated commercial acumen with the ability to act as a trusted peer to Senior Sales Leadership and Enterprise Account Executives.
  • Hands-on experience using CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo) to track event ROI, account attendance depth, and pipeline conversion across the funnel.
  • Exceptional organisational discipline and project management skills to handle multiple complex event activations simultaneously.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

*Desired:

  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) methodologies and account-level pipeline tracking within enterprise SaaS.

Location

This role will be remote, and based in the UK.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to learn from each other. For this role, approximately 25–30% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way across the DACH region.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

The successful candidate's starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

title: Principal Technical Marketing Engineer | UK | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

As Grafana’s offering shifts from dashboards to industry-leading agentic observability, our Product Marketing team is responsible for closing the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. That means building clear, consistent positioning, enabling sellers with trustworthy technical narratives, and creating content that helps Platform Engineering teams quickly grasp why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

As a Technical Product Marketer you will play a critical part in that transformation. You’ll be the hands-on engineer who brings our technical story to life for buyers, not just practitioners. You’ll build core demos, run technical workshops and webinars, and act as the technical bridge between our Product and Sales orgs. Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

What You'll Be Doing:

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

  • Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos that highlight Grafana’s value for SRE and platform engineering leaders.
  • Record high-quality technical demo videos and walkthroughs in partnership with our video and content teams.
  • Lead webinars, workshops, and technical sessions designed for evaluators.
  • Teach customers not just how Grafana works, but why our approach is differentiated and valuable.
  • Use AI tools to generate variations, summaries, and reusable assets that scale technical content across channels.

Enable Solutions (Sales) Engineers with clear, consistent technical storytelling

  • Serve as PMM’s technical liaison to the SE org, ensuring consistent messaging and demo guidance.
  • Produce technical enablement assets, value-driven talk tracks, competitive narratives, and demo best practices.
  • Help SEs and sellers communicate Grafana’s story with clarity, confidence, and differentiation.

Collaborate with PMMs to drive technical buyer engagement across high-impact channels

  • Partner with PMMs to identify the most important buyer personas, problems, and technical messages, and help shape the content strategy needed to reach them.
  • Extend technical narratives into impactful buyer-facing channels including analyst briefings (Gartner, Forrester), industry forums, podcasts, conferences, and online technical communities.
  • Bring a technical perspective to PMM planning—helping ensure our content, campaigns, and enablement reflect the real challenges and priorities of SREs and engineering leaders.

Use automation & AI to scale technical content

  • Partner with software engineers to streamline demo setup, content workflows, and asset updates through workflows, agents, scripts, and AI-driven tools.
  • Use automation to make technical content more repeatable, discoverable, and scalable across teams.

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • 5+ years in a technical role (solutions engineering, SRE, DevOps, backend engineering, technical PMM, or similar).
  • Interest and ability to travel to training and customer events 10-12 weeks per year.
  • Strong understanding of observability concepts and the needs of SRE/platform teams.
  • Ability to translate deep technical concepts into clear, value-focused stories.
  • Experience presenting technical content through demos, workshops, or webinars.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with a crisp, structured, persuasive style.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration; comfort working with PMM, Product, SEs, DevRel, and Field Engineering.
  • High ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from concept to completion.
  • Comfort with light scripting or workflow automation.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on experience with Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, Tempo, or similar observability tools, or a background in Observability or Platform Engineering.
  • Prior experience in Sales Engineering, DevRel, or technical product marketing.
  • Familiarity with demo environment automation or infrastructure-as-code tools.
  • Exceptional live presentation or workshop facilitation skills.

Compensation & Rewards:

In the UK, the base compensation range for this role is GBP 103,958- GBP 124,750. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer: Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

#LI-Remote

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

description:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Title: Team Lead, Customer Support

Location: Remote, UK

Experience: M1

Job Function: Support

Employment Type: Permanent, Full Time

Industry: Computer & Network Security

About the position

Customer Support Team Lead oversees regional leadership of a specific support tier (Tier 1, 2, or 3) within [EMEA/APAC/US], managing engineers, handling escalations, and ensuring exceptional customer service and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

  • Leads, mentors, and develops a team of customer support engineers ensuring they have the necessary tools, training, and knowledge to excel in their roles.
  • Ensure timely closures of tickets and SLAs are met within the team.
  • Promotes knowledge sharing within the team to enhance overall support capability and efficiency.
  • Promotes customer communication via live channels, not email.
  • Handles enterprise customers requiring a higher level of expertise.
  • Provides constructive feedback, and creates personalized development and improvement plans to foster career growth.
  • Fosters a positive and collaborative team environment that encourages continuous improvement and high performance.
  • Ensures the delivery of high-quality support services, focusing on timely and effective issue resolution and maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Manages customer escalations, providing timely and accurate solutions while maintaining effective communication with customers.
  • Addresses dissatisfied customer feedback with the regional manager to improve customer loyalty and reduce churn risk related to support engagements.
