description:
Headquarters: Remote - New York

 SLSQ327R321

 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

 Databricks is seeking a Lakebase Associate Director to help customers modernize their operational data foundation with Databricks Lakebase, our fully-managed Postgres offering for intelligent applications. This high-impact role sits within the Lakebase Go-To-Market team and partners closely with Industry Account Executives within our Financial Services vertical to drive adoption of Lakebase with platform, application, and data teams.

 Lakebase gives customers a unified, governed foundation for operational workloads and AI-native applications, helping them move away from a fragmented estate of point databases toward a modern, scalable, serverless Postgres service. If you want to be at the forefront of operational databases for AI and intelligent applications at one of the fastest-growing data and AI companies in the world, this is your opportunity.

 The impact you will have

• Drive new Lakebase revenue by identifying, qualifying, and driving Lakebase activations and consumption within a defined territory, in partnership with regional Account Executives and the broader account team.

• Lead with outcomes for key Lakebase personas — including platform teams and developers, data teams, and central IT — articulating how Lakebase helps them ship features faster, simplify operational data architectures, and improve governance and cost efficiency.

• Sell the value of fully-managed Postgres for intelligent applications, positioning Lakebase as the optimal choice for operational workloads that power real-time, AI-driven experiences.

• Run complex, multi-threaded sales cycles from discovery and value hypothesis through commercial negotiation and close, navigating executive, technical, and line-of-business stakeholders.

• Orchestrate proof-of-value and POCs that validate Lakebase’s benefits for OLTP-style workloads, reverse ETL, and AI/ML-driven applications, in partnership with solution architects and specialists.

• Compete and win against legacy and cloud-native operational databases by leveraging our compete assets, benchmarks, and customer references.

• Align to measurable business outcomes such as performance, developer productivity, time-to-market for new features, cost reduction, and simplification of the operational data landscape.

• Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, Customer Success, and Partner teams to shape territory plans, launch plays, and co-selling motions with key ISVs and GSIs.

• Enable the field by sharing Lakebase best practices, success stories, and sales motions with broader sales teams, helping scale Lakebase proficiency across the organization.

 What success looks like in this role

 This role requires the ability to operate across two key motions simultaneously:

• Establish top strategic focus accounts by engaging application development teams to create net-new intelligent applications leveraging Lakebase.

• Drive longer-term Postgres standardization and migration within Databricks' most strategic accounts.

 Candidates should demonstrate how they can act as a force multiplier across multiple dimensions of the business.

 Success in this role requires strength in four areas:

• Business ownership – Operate at a business-unit level by tracking revenue, pipeline, and key observations, and by identifying areas needing additional focus or support.

• Strategic account engagement – Partner with account teams to engage priority accounts across the global DB700, driving strategic opportunities from initial engagement through successful outcomes.

• Field, account, & customer enablement: Align customers and the field on the value of Lakebase by equipping AEs and SAs with the messaging and execution motions needed to confidently own accounts without specialist intervention.

• Market voice and thought leadership – Develop an internal and external presence by contributing to global AMAs and internal forums, and by representing Databricks at key first- and third-party events.

 The interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across all four of these dimensions.

 What we look for

• 7+ years of enterprise SaaS sales experience, consistently exceeding quota in complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

• Proven success selling data platforms, operational databases (e.g., Postgres, MySQL, cloud-native DBaaS), or adjacent data/AI infrastructure to technical buyers and business leaders.

• Strong understanding of modern data and application architectures, including cloud-native services, microservices, event-driven systems, and how operational data underpins AI and analytics strategies.

• Ability to sell to both technical stakeholders (developers, architects, data engineers) and business stakeholders (product leaders, operations, line-of-business owners).

• Demonstrated experience leading specialist or overlay motions, working jointly with core Account Executives to create and progress opportunities.

• Executive presence with the ability to whiteboard architectures, lead C-level conversations, and build trust with senior decision makers.

• Strong value selling skills: adept at discovering pain, building a business case, and tying technical capabilities to clear, quantified outcomes.

• Excellent communication, storytelling, and negotiation skills, with comfort presenting to both large and small audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience selling Postgres, operational databases, OLTP workloads, or transactional cloud database services, ideally within large or strategic accounts.

• Familiarity with data platforms, Lakehouse architectures, and cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP), including how operational databases fit within broader data and AI strategies.

• Understanding of reverse ETL, real-time decisioning, and operational analytics use cases, and how they drive value for customer-facing and internal applications.

• Exposure to AI-native and agent-driven applications that depend on low-latency, highly scalable operational data services.

• Prior experience in a high-growth, category-creating environment, helping shape new plays, messaging, and customer narratives.

• Experience collaborating with partners and ISVs to drive joint pipeline and co-sell motions.

At this level of seniority, non-technical skills, learning & teaching, and business acumen are critical, along with the expectation of technical excellence, as you will help drive technical decision-making and solutioning of key technical challenges both within the team and across the Analytics Community. The technical day-to-day will primarily be within the Data Platform built using Snowflake, Dataiku & GitHub. The primary development will focus on GenAI Platform Capabilities, Python & SQL (among other languages), DataOps processes built within GitHub Actions & Dataiku, and data platform processes built within Snowflake & Dataiku. Strong software development lifecycle knowledge and DataOps skills are a must! The ideal candidate is naturally curious, has excellent verbal and written communication skills, has a sharp analytical mind, a positive attitude towards work and thrives when collaborating towards a shared goal. This is an internal and non-client facing role.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Be an expert-level engineer across Dataiku (Platform Automation, GenAI Capabilities, Plugin Development, maintenance & troubleshooting) and Snowflake (data engineering, security/governance), including building & maintaining GenAI Platform solutions with a security/governance focus
  • Build & maintain Python & SQL-based platform automation and DataOps processes for SDLC delivery
  • Build & maintain data quality, observability, monitoring, alerting, access management, and platform transparency systems
  • Assist Data Engineering with Python & SQL data replication & pipelines on large, complex datasets
  • Design data models (short- and long-term) to support data warehouse scalability
  • Collaborate with GenAI Engineering & Analytics Engineering to build scalable Data Platform solutions
  • Perform root cause analysis on complex errors to ensure pipeline availability
  • Help drive technical & architectural decisions on the data platform (architecture, engineering processes, data quality, security/governance frameworks, DataOps, consumption models)
  • Test new Dataiku and partner-tool features, provide feedback, and assess value for internal integration
  • Work closely with stakeholders (Infra, embedded analytics, Product, Engineering) on implementation & requirements gathering, while promoting the Data Platform internally through mentoring, innovation initiatives, and contributions to EDA team standards and best practices

Some expected outcomes for this role

  • A more secure, well-governed GenAI layer on top of the Data Platform, with clear standards for engineering delivery
  • Measurable improvements in data quality, observability, and platform reliability (fewer/faster-resolved incidents via RCA)
  • Stronger, more automated DataOps/SDLC processes reducing manual overhead across the team
  • Scalable data models that support the platform’s growth across Analytics, GenAI Engineering, and self-service users
  • Closer technical alignment between Data Platforms, GenAI Engineering, and Analytics Engineering on shared solutions

What you’ll need to be successful

  • Strong understanding of GenAI development, security & governance concepts — a must
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform Engineering / Data Architecture
  • Expert-level SQL & Python; Snowflake experience required
  • Prior experience with DevOps technologies (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jenkins)
  • Strong understanding of data architecture & data modeling concepts
  • Prior experience building and maintaining replication & data pipelines in a cloud data warehouse or data lake environment
  • Experience working with complex stakeholders: dissecting vague asks and defining tangible requirements
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities in a high-trust remote environment, wearing multiple hats as needed
  • Excellent analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with a passion for continuous learning and teaching, and the ability to produce clear, precise documentation

What will make you stand out

  • Dataiku DSS experience
  • Demonstrated track record of mentoring or upskilling other engineers on new technologies or platform practices
  • Experience delivering GenAI architecture guidance directly to business/senior stakeholders

description:
What We Do:

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 17M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

Location: Remote UK

Compensation Range: £190,000 to £200,000 on-target earnings (60/40 split) plus equity

What You’ll Do:

As the EMEA Distribution Channel Manager, you'll be a key player in expanding Huntress's reach and impact. In this hands-on role, you'll be responsible for identifying, developing, and nurturing relationships with our distributor partners to open new high-volume channels and amplify the Huntress brand. You'll report directly to the Director of Channel and Strategic Alliances.

You'll work closely with internal teams and external stakeholders to identify opportunities, develop strategic initiatives, and drive the execution and long-term success of our distributor programs. Your efforts will directly contribute to increasing Huntress's revenues and market presence through these vital partnerships.

Distributor Partnership Development & Management:

title: Staff QE, Mobile
description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Team:

Our diverse Product & Engineering team values innovation, collaboration, and the continuous improvement of our platform. We offer a dynamic work environment where employees can grow and thrive while working on cutting-edge technology that shapes the future of AI and search.

At AlphaSense, we believe that diverse experiences and perspectives are critical to our success. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered to be their authentic selves.

About the Role:

Investors and analysts open our app between meetings, on a train, before a call, and act on what they see. Mobile releases go through app stores and cannot be rolled back, so a problem can stay in customers' hands for days.

Our mobile product is growing fast, with new AI workflows arriving on iPhone, iPad and Android at the pace of the rest of the platform. Our quality practice has real foundations, including Appium and native UI test suites and real-device runs, but our newest features are ahead of our automated coverage, and release confidence still depends too much on individual effort.

As Staff Quality Engineer, you own one question: can we ship mobile with confidence, every release, on all platforms? You decide what we test and what we deliberately leave out, and you turn what you build into a way of working that Mobile Engineering owns with you.

You will report to the head of Quality Engineering and work day to day with the iOS and Android teams, alongside backend, web and platform QE.

What Makes this a Staff role:

  • You set direction, not a task list. Nobody hands you a test plan. You look at the product, the release risk and the team, and decide what matters most and why.
  • You own the outcome across platforms. Your scope is the quality of the product across clients, not one app or one team.
  • You work through influence. You are an individual contributor. Your standards stick because engineers see their value, and success means they write more testable code, make better release calls and need you less over time.

What You’ll Do:

  • Define mobile quality strategy. Set the long-term strategy built on "Quality by Design" and "Automation by Default": test layers, device and OS matrix, and release criteria for iOS and Android.
  • Set metrics the team can act on. Define quality metrics and coverage standards with Mobile Engineering and Product, so quality is measurable and sustainable without you.
  • Turn release day into a clear call. With no instant rollback, own the quality gates, staged rollouts and evidence behind every go or no-go decision.
  • Connect mobile to the rest of the platform. Mobile shares APIs and services with web, and customers update apps slowly, so changes elsewhere can break mobile after they have shipped. You are accountable for that risk.
  • Make the test platform dependable. Keep real-device and CI runs stable and fast (Bitrise, BrowserStack, GitLab, Allure), including test data and enterprise (Intune/MDM) builds.
  • Use AI where it earns its place. Use tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot yourself, and help the team decide where they help and where human judgment must lead.
  • Leave the team stronger. Coach engineers and QEs, review designs for testability, and leave behind standards other teams adopt.

What Success looks like:

  • First 90 days: You have audited current coverage, agreed a prioritized plan with Mobile Engineering and delivered your first measurable improvement.
  • By 6 months: Critical mobile journeys are covered in the right layers on both platforms, and release readiness is an evidence-based call.
  • By 12 months: Mobile quality is a practice the team owns, and other portfolios borrow your ideas.

Who You Are:

  • A quality engineer with 8+ years of experience, including 2+ at Staff or Lead level. You have connected quality strategy across web and mobile, not just worked on mobile alone, and set direction across several teams or apps as an individual contributor without people-management authority. You can show what changed because of it.
  • Strong hands-on experience testing native mobile apps on at least one platform (iOS or Android), with working knowledge of the other. You are comfortable with real-device cloud and CI/CD for mobile builds, can work with tools such as XCUITest, Espresso, Compose UI testing or Appium, and code in at least one language such as Kotlin, Java, Swift or Python.
  • Strong debugging skills across the mobile stack, from crash reports to network traces, and a good understanding of how mobile releases move through the app stores.
  • Excellent test design and API testing, and comfortable in the backend: you can read APIs, debug across the client and service boundary, and work with contracts.
  • Strong understanding of continuous delivery and release gating, with experience in test management systems such as Allure TestOps.
  • An active AI tool user, with examples of where it helped and where it fell short.
  • Practical about trade-offs, and able to explain a release call to engineers and to non-technical leaders.

Bonus points:

  • Enterprise mobile experience (MDM/MAM, Intune, SSO, mobile security standards such as OWASP MASVS).
  • Experience building a mobile quality practice from an early stage.
  • Mobile performance testing (app start time, memory, battery) and release monitoring (crash and performance signals, staged rollouts).
  • Experience across both iOS and Android.

What we offer:

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

title: Community Lead & Talent Acquisition Advisor - EMEA
description:
Hi, I’m Kayla :) I lead global community activation within Partnerships at Ashby. Before joining a year ago, I spent 15 years in TA and was an Ashby customer. I made the move out of TA into this role, and nothing I’d learned has gone to waste. If anything, I’ve learnt even more from the community. It’s genuinely one of the most rewarding and fun roles I’ve had, and as I step into a leadership role, I’m on the hunt for someone to take over the work in EMEA and evolve it further.

We’re hiring an experienced TA Expert & Community Lead to grow one of our most successful GTM experiments: a high-touch, customer-led approach to growth. The model is already working in EMEA, built on curated events, product education and early community activation. You’ll own it across our target markets (UK&I, France, Nordics and Benelux), from customer breakfasts and curated experiences to enablement sessions and product demos.

This role suits someone who has worked with Ashby All-in-One, has a solid background in TA, and cares about tools, process, hospitality and community building. It also works well for TA people who still love the work but want to use what they know somewhere new. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Product Marketing, own a region end-to-end, and see how community connects to pipeline and retention.

A quick summary on travel, since it’s usually the first question and we know it means time away from home: you’ll have events in London regularly, plus one trip to another EMEA city a month, usually for around four days. Busier periods can mean two trips abroad in a month. There is flex, though. I’m a mum of three, and in this role, I’ve been able to stay home and take meaningful time off during every school holiday. We plan the calendar well in advance, so you’ll know what’s coming and can sort things at home with plenty of notice.

It’s also one of the best parts of the job. I’ve met some amazing people and had some really cool experiences along the way, from hosting a dinner cruise on the Seine and a TA leader workshop with a partner at the Shangri-La Paris, to spending time in customers’ offices in Stockholm, our company offsite in Playa Del Carmen, and hosting the mainstage at our first Ashby One London.

What you’ll do

  • Lead EMEA Community Events

    • Run community events across target EMEA markets. Event types might include:

      • Customer learning breakfasts

      • A mixed ecosystem event for customers and prospects

      • Partner cocktail events or roundtables co-hosted with local ecosystem players

    • Build and nurture relationships with TA leaders

    • Partner with Event Ops on venue selection, invites, and post-event recaps

    • Drive improvement and reimagine how we can show up in a very meaningful way for the community

  • Drive Customer Education

    • Become an Expert in Ashby + TA leader needs to curate relevant content

    • Design and lead live sessions that help customers activate key Ashby features and keep customers ahead on key TA trends and topics

    • Partner with CS and Product Marketing teams on the Ashby Hidden Gems program

    • Develop and distribute product tips, dashboards, and templates to increase customer sophistication

  • Expand EMEA Community and Customer Advocacy

    • Help Ashby deepen its brand and trust by showing up consistently and thoughtfully

    • Participate in and help advise on content for ACE (Ashby Customer Expert) events when we bring the program to EMEA

    • Partner with GTM teams on prospect and customer onsite visits

    • Moderate panels, attend events, and build a presence at industry gatherings

Who you’ll work with

You’ll report directly to me, but work closely with myself and Willem, who has pioneered what community growth looks like at Ashby. Within partnerships, you’ll also work closely with Katie to scale trusted community partner relationships and Louise to bring Owned Community experiences, like Ashby Cafe, to life. You’ll also partner day to day with our EMEA Sales and CS teams, who know our customers and prospects best and help shape who we bring into the room.

About You

We think the ideal person for this role will have experience and skills that look something like this:

  • You’ve been an Ashby power user or at least very familiar with Ashby and seen its benefits first-hand—someone who knows the product and Ashby community, champions good recruiting practices, and isn’t afraid to dive into dashboards, workflows, or templates

  • You’ve built a reputation inside organizations as the go-to expert on TA process and tooling

  • You’re a strong communicator—whether facilitating a breakfast, writing a post-event summary, or helping a customer understand how to build a dashboard

  • You love curating and connecting people and ideas. You get energy from hosting, matchmaking, and finding smart formats to share what works

  • You’re excited about being on the road ~2x/month and tapping into your existing network (and growing it!) in the TA space

  • You have strong business acumen. You understand how community supports the wider business and work well with Sales and CS to make sure our programs are reaching the right people

description:
As a Senior Enterprise Sales Engineer, you’ll serve as a trusted technical advisor and strategic partner to both customers and Sales. You’ll lead complex technical evaluations, align solutions to business outcomes, and help shape deal strategy in high-impact opportunities.

This role goes beyond delivering demos - you’ll own the evaluation experience end-to-end, influence key stakeholders, and help drive successful outcomes across enterprise accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical strategy across your accounts as a peer to the Account Executive - a standing weekly 1:1 with each AE you support, and a standing weekly account team call with the full ecosystem where you carry POV status, technical blockers, and the explanation behind any usage movement.
  • Own the technical explanation behind consumption movement in your accounts. Work with the CSM and TAM to separate legitimate growth from misconfiguration, make sure legitimate growth gets quantified before renewal, and flag forward-looking usage the customer has signalled rather than explaining it backwards a month later.
  • Lead discovery in every meeting, not only in discovery meetings - including meetings where you were invited to present. Leave each meeting knowing something about their business you did not know going in.
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, solution workshops, etc. that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes for diverse stakeholder audiences including executives
  • Full ownership of the technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining competitive success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify, develop, and leverage technical champions across multi-stakeholder environments, building a structured plan for champion cultivation and influence throughout the deal cycle and beyond
  • Contribute to product direction through active participation in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, bringing field insights and customer patterns to PM and engineering teams
  • Drive operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems
  • Identify and proactively resolve technical and organizational blockers by collaborating across Product, Support, and GTM teams before customers are impacted
  • Contribute to team enablement by mentoring peers, sharing best practices, and creating reusable assets that scale knowledge across the region

Who You Are:

  • 7+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at influencing and adapting communication across technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Advanced background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • Experience displacing or consolidating away from an entrenched incumbent inside an account where that incumbent has internal advocates
  • A consultative, outcome - oriented approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Demonstrated depth over breadth. You have worked a very small number of very large organisations over long horizons, and can describe how your understanding of one account compounded across quarters.
  • Experience mentoring peers or contributing to team enablement initiatives
  • Demonstrated capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it
  • Growth mindset of embracing change and being curious
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

title: Staff Product Designer - Platform Design
description:
The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.

Spotify runs on the tools we've built for ourselves. They help hundreds of teams ship every day to hundreds of millions of people around the world. Now, we're sharing them.

Spotify Technology brings our proven tools and services together for engineering organisations everywhere, from global enterprises to individual developers. As AI reshapes how software gets made, we're building on years of experience solving complex engineering challenges at scale.

Platform Design makes these powerful tools feel effortless. We shape the services, products and experiences used by Spotify's engineering teams and by developers around the world. We believe great design is a competitive advantage, and developer tools deserve the same care and craft as any consumer product.

As a Staff Product Designer, you'll combine product leadership with hands-on design and engineering. You'll shape the experience strategy for a key part of the Spotify Technology portfolio, establish a distinctive visual language, and turn internal tools into products customers love using. You'll work closely with product, engineering and marketing partners, reporting to the Spotify Technology Design Director.

What You'll Do

  • Lead complex design challenges from early exploration through to production, creating intuitive flows, interfaces, interactions and motion that make powerful developer tools easier to use.
  • Shape the visual language of Spotify Technology, bringing consistency, personality and craft across product experiences and brand touchpoints.
  • Transform tools built for Spotify's engineering teams into compelling commercial products that meet the needs of developers and enterprise customers.
  • Bring design to life in code, building and shipping high-quality front-end experiences with close attention to performance, accessibility and detail.
  • Set experience strategy across your product area, partnering with product and engineering leaders to influence priorities, guide decisions and shape the roadmap.
  • Use prototypes, storytelling and experimentation to make complex ideas tangible, build alignment and help teams navigate trade-offs.
  • Explore how generative AI and agentic tools can improve design and development workflows, while creating thoughtful experiences for products used by people and AI agents.
  • Raise the bar for design craft across the team, championing design systems, inclusive experiences and a culture of collaboration, feedback and continuous learning.

Who You Are

  • You have a strong background in product design, with experience shaping complex digital products and delivering high-quality visual and interaction design.
  • You're comfortable working across strategy and execution, setting a clear product direction while staying close to the details of design and delivery.
  • You can build and ship user interfaces using a modern front-end technology stack, and enjoy bringing your designs into production.
  • You understand how to create cohesive visual experiences across product and brand, with a thoughtful approach to interaction, motion and design systems.
  • You bring an understanding of developer tools, enterprise software or platform products, including the challenges of designing for technical audiences.
  • You use generative AI and agentic tools in your work, applying sound judgement about where they add value and where human expertise matters most.
  • You're comfortable navigating ambiguity, using research, data and customer insights to make informed decisions and solve complex problems.
  • You communicate ideas clearly, build trust across disciplines and influence product decisions through compelling design work and storytelling.
  • You care about helping others grow, welcome different perspectives and contribute to an inclusive, collaborative environment where great work can happen.

Where You'll Be

  • This role is based in London, UK or Stockholm, Sweden
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.

Compensation

title: Manager, EMEA Community (Contract)

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the UK as a fixed-term leave cover.

We are seeking a strategic community management professional to join our International Community Team, and lead a growing team in EMEA. As the Manager of Community for EMEA, you will spearhead the development and execution of the community strategy that supports Reddit’s growth in the region.

In this role, you will lead a team of Community Specialists and will take charge of defining the roadmap for community activation and moderation across focus markets, and help develop our international playbook.

Your work will focus on experimenting, iterating, and refining processes that drive community engagement at scale. The insights you generate through these efforts will accelerate Reddit’s growth in EMEA, and serve as a model for other emerging markets. This role reports to the Director, International Community.

Responsibilities:

  • Craft and champion the regional community strategy, ensuring alignment with overall team and business goals.
  • Drive the iteration, innovation, and scaling of the community and moderator growth playbook, proactively identifying new opportunities and launching bold initiatives in key markets.
  • Inspire and empower regional teams to execute impactful programs that elevate local communities, and their markets. Encourage innovation and create an environment of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Recruit, onboard, and train local community specialists in key markets to strengthen our collaboration with moderators and drive community engagement.

  • Own community-health and growth outcomes across priority markets, including KPI progression, moderator coverage and retention, and the impact of community-building initiatives.
  • Coordinate with Content, Growth, Product and relevant safety partners to deliver market initiatives and surface local needs for broader roadmap decisions.

Required qualifications:

  • 5-7 years of experience in community management or marketing operations, including at least 1-2 years in a leadership role, with a proven track record of driving community growth and delivering business impact through community-led or marketing projects.
  • Organized with a strong ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
  • Problem-solver with excellent interpersonal skills, capable of collaborating with diverse cross-functional teams and influencing them to adopt a community-first mindset.
  • Comfortable testing, iterating, and adjusting strategies to find the optimal approach for each market.
  • Skilled at navigating ambiguous environments and experimenting with different approaches to achieve results in focus markets.
  • Data-driven and results-oriented, with a keen ability to translate insights into action.
  • Deep understanding of Reddit’s unique identity, and the critical role communities and moderators play in adding value to the platform and enhancing user experiences.

Bonus Points

 Who we are

 About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 Stripe's Developer & End-user Experience Platform (DEEP) organization empowers all of Stripe's products with a shared product platform that helps with rapidly delivering high-quality, cross-product experiences across our UI and API surfaces. It focuses on providing a consistent and scalable developer experience that any developer (both internal and external) can leverage to accelerate a merchant's ability to create value using Stripe.

Our team collaborates with many cross-functional teams—from Infrastructure to Product—at Stripe to deliver innovative solutions that address evolving user needs.

• Debug and solve critical production issues across services and multiple levels of the stack

 Minimum requirements

• 2–12+ years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)

• Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)

• Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success

• Ability to thrive with a high level of autonomy and responsibility, with an entrepreneurial mindset

• Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

 Preferred qualifications

• Experience with large-scale financial tracking systems

• Good understanding and practical knowledge in cloud-based services (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL, Docker and Kubernetes, cloud services such as AWS, etc.)

 Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

 Ads powers Reddit’s mission to bring community, belonging, and empowerment to everyone in the world. The Advertiser Platform organization owns ads.reddit.com, Reddit’s core advertiser-facing product.

 We’re looking for a mid-level frontend engineer to join our Ads Manager team. Our team includes frontend and backend engineers who build tools that help advertisers create and manage campaigns at scale. We make complex advertising workflows easier to use, with a focus on performance and reliability.

 In this role, you’ll own medium-sized frontend projects. You’ll help clarify requirements, propose technical solutions, and carry your work through implementation and release. You’ll make progress independently, collaborate with teammates on tradeoffs, and ask for input when you need it.

 Responsibilities

• Build intuitive, accessible interfaces that help advertisers create and manage campaigns.

• Partner with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to turn advertiser needs into scoped projects.

• Own technical design, implementation, testing, and release for medium-sized frontend projects.

• Communicate progress, dependencies, and risks early so partners can plan around them.

• Review code and document technical decisions to help the team maintain and extend its work.

• Improve frontend performance and reliability, address bugs, and contribute reusable components and patterns.

 Requirements

• 3+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years in frontend engineering.

• Experience building and maintaining production web applications.

• Ability to break down a project, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and deliver a solution independently.

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to problem-solving.

• Experience writing maintainable code, testing your work, and participating in code reviews.

title: Associate Director, Music Policy, Spotify for Artists
description:
We’re looking for a leader to manage Spotify’s Music Policy team, driving our strategy and execution for many of the most important issues facing the music industry for the next decade. As our Head of Music Policy, you will lead the team shaping the rules, standards, and incentives governing Spotify’s music ecosystem, positively impacting millions of artists around the world.

The music policy team focuses on developing and implementing policies that further our mission to provide a fair and equitable opportunity for artists, songwriters, distributors, labels, and publishers on Spotify — as well as educating the music industry about our approach. The role requires a deep understanding of the music supply chain, and will work heavily in collaboration with our tech and product teams, as well as our artist partnerships team, to build and roll out policy solutions. 

The scope of policies include how Spotify’s $11 billion+ annual royalty pool is allocated; owning policy programs like Verified by Spotify, AI Persona labeling, AI Credits, and Music Spam Filter; tactics to remove incentives for bad actors and spammers; guardrails and rules for content providers around platform integrity and metadata; and strategies to future proof our platform for new trends or technologies in the music industry, like AI. In communicating these policies publicly, our focus is to educate artists and the music industry at scale, so everyone has equal access to information and resources.

In this role, you’ll work with a cross-functional team from Licensing, Marketing, Public Affairs, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Music Partnerships, Music Economics, and more in leading policy initiatives for the Spotify for Artists team — from the strategy, development, and implementation of new policies, to public messaging and education, to industry advocacy and engagement.

You’ll move integrations from bespoke infrastructure onto shared platform capabilities, design SDKs that enable other teams and customers to build integrations independently, and safely retire older implementations. You’ll also build observability and diagnostic tools that help users understand, monitor, and troubleshoot their connections. You’ll own improvements from design through production and use what you learn from operating connectors to strengthen the platform they share.

title: Principal Enterprise Architect
description:
Headquarters: India (remote)

 Enterprise Architect - Cloud & AI

 Role Overview

 Jumio is not just processing transactions; we are pioneering the future of identity intelligence. To lead this transformation, you serve as a visionary AI Adoption Catalyst and Systems Architect , redefining our technical landscape. In this role, you aren’t a traditional gatekeeper—you are a Developer Advocate and mission-driven leader. You take end-to-end ownership of our architecture, positioning machine learning and GenAI at the heart of our DNA. Leveraging your deep expertise in AWS and cloud-native engineering, you provide the engine that empowers our developers to innovate at lightning speed, ensuring our multi-tenant SaaS platform remains the global benchmark for performance and scale.

 This is a mandate for a technical doer who thrives on the front lines. Building on our strong, scalable cloud foundation, you will actively champion the adoption of GenAI tools across the software development lifecycle while driving continuous architectural improvement, evolution, and operational cost optimization. Your proven experience in AWS is the toolkit you use to clear architectural roadblocks and optimize performance, enabling engineering teams to move with unprecedented velocity.

 As a strategic technical leader who stays close to the code, you inspire an AI-First culture. You bridge the gap between visionary enterprise design and pragmatic execution, driving cross-departmental impact while fostering self-service capabilities and cloud efficiency to ensure that as Jumio grows, our technology scales predictably and elegantly.

 Key Responsibilities

 End-to-End System Architecture & Optimization

• Own the technical vision for scalable, high-performance, cost-efficient systems.

• Define modern architecture patterns that enable growth, high TPS, and seamless scaling.

• Architect and optimize multi-tenant SaaS platforms, ensuring configurability and performance.

• Design self-service capabilities to reduce engineering overhead (e.g., self-service workflow designer, self-service rules engine, self-service reporting).

• Lead cloud cost efficiency initiatives, optimizing infrastructure, model execution, and compute resources.

• Collaborate closely with AWS Support and Solution Architects to optimize infrastructure and leverage cutting-edge cloud capabilities.

 Data & AI Infrastructure

• Architect high-scale, distributed data processing pipelines for batch and real-time workloads.

• Optimize data storage, retrieval, and processing layers to enhance system performance and reduce cost.

• Enable data self-service for analytics, ML, and real-time business use cases.

• Ensure data governance, security, and compliance across all systems.

 Technical Leadership & Hands-on Architecture

• Guide engineering teams on architectural best practices and pragmatic execution.

• Coach teams on scalable microservices, event-driven architectures, and cloud-native patterns.

• Practice "Architecting by Example" through technical prototyping and proof-of-concepts to validate architectural decisions.

 GenAI Acceleration & Architectural Advocacy

• You serve as the AI Adoption Catalyst and engineering champion, actively partnering with developers and business units to integrate LLMs and agentic workflows that securely hyper-automate the development lifecycle.

• You clear roadblocks and deploy agile architectural guardrails that empower teams to experiment rapidly with automated AI tools, building a self-service AI culture while maintaining rigorous cost-performance optimization.

• Your leadership evolves architectural governance into a collaborative platform for ensuring system-wide coherence, security, and world-class scalability.

 Architectural Governance & ARC Leadership

• Lead the Jumio Architecture Review Council (ARC) to drive cross-functional alignment and the evolution of our technical landscape.

• Establish and enforce architectural standards, ensuring consistency, security, and scalability across all product teams.

• Facilitate cross-team architectural reviews to identify technical debt, drive alignment, and ensure strategic coherence.

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for complex architectural trade-offs, balancing immediate delivery needs with long-term system health.

• Mentor engineering leadership on architectural best practices and standardized decision-making processes.

 Who You Are

• Strategic Visionary—you connect long-term business goals with robust technical roadmaps.

• Ultra-technical—you design, build, and optimize systems with a hands-on approach.

• System-First Thinker—you prioritize architecture, efficiency, and scale in every decision.

• Cloud-Native Expert—you utilize your deep AWS knowledge to optimize costs while improving system performance.

• Pragmatic Decision Maker—your impact-driven solutions ensure technical excellence without sacrificing speed.

• Builder’s Mentality—you thrive on automation, self-service, and reducing engineering toil through GenAI adoption.

• Growth-Oriented Mentor—you teach, coach, and elevate the engineering teams through architectural advocacy.

 Must-Have Skills & Experience

• 12+ years of hands-on experience in system architecture, data engineering, cloud engineering, or technical leadership roles.

• Experience with multi-tenant architectures and designing frameworks for configurable SaaS platforms.

• Deep, hands-on expertise in AWS (e.g., EKS, IAM, Lambda, networking) is required; professional experience with GCP is a strong plus.

• Strong experience with distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and caching strategies.

• Hands-on knowledge of AI/ML model execution—understanding model inference performance, cost trade-offs, and optimization strategies.

• Proficiency in high-scale transactional systems.

• Experience with infrastructure automation (Terraform, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Docker).

• Strong coding skills (Expert in Java, Strong in Python, Knowledgeable in JavaScript/TypeScript & Kotlin).

• Strong experience leading architectural review processes and fostering engineering standards.

• Proven expertise in integrating GenAI and ML methodologies into the software development lifecycle.

• Proven ability in strategic stakeholder management and complex financial/TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) analysis for enterprise technology.

 Nice-to-Have Skills

• Experience with high-volume, real-time data processing and distributed streaming architectures.

• Experience building petabyte-scale distributed data platforms.

• Familiarity with fraud prevention, identity verification, or authentication technologies.

 Why Join Us?

• Impact at scale —we process millions of transactions and solve real-world security and identity challenges .

• Modern technical foundation with room to innovate —leverage our established, scalable cloud architecture while actively driving continuous modernization, operational cost optimization, and solving complex technical challenges.

• Hands-on architecture leadership —you won’t be stuck in meetings; you’ll drive execution.

• Work alongside top engineers and AI/ML experts , pushing the limits of what’s possible.

• Competitive compensation and high ownership —your work will define how Jumio scales.

 Jumio Values:

 IDEAL: Integrity, Diversity, Empowerment, Accountability, Leading Innovation

 Equal Opportunities :

 Jumio is a collaboration of people with different ideas, strengths, interests and cultures. We welcome applications and colleagues from all backgrounds and of all statuses.

 About Jumio:

 Jumio is a B2B technology company dedicated to eradicating online identity fraud, money laundering and other financial crimes to help make the internet safer. We leverage AI, biometrics, machine learning, liveness detection and automation to create solutions that are trusted by leading brands worldwide and respected by industry thought leaders.

 Jumio is the leading provider of online identity verification, eKYC and AML solutions. With a global footprint, we’re expanding the team to meet strong client demand across a range of industries including Financial Services, Travel, Sharing Economy, Fintech, Gaming, and others.

 Applicant Data Privacy

 We will only use your personal information in connection with Jumio’s application, recruitment, and hiring processes, as described in Jumio’s Applicant Privacy Notice. If you have any questions or comments, please send an email to privacy@jumio.com .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/jumio-principal-enterprise-architect

description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Job Title: HR Enablement Lead

 Job Location: United States, Remote

 This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.

 ABOUT THE COMPANY:

 Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

 With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

 Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

 THE OPPORTUNITY:

 At Salesloft, as our HR Enablement Lead, you will be a pivotal member of our high-performing People team. Reporting to [manager, confirm], you will own the creation of learning programs and lead high-impact enablement workshops from beginning to end, and you will help build a cohesive, seamless learning journey for our global workforce. You'll have designated programs that you own end to end, from conception through execution, with hands-on support from leadership as the team builds out its capabilities together.

 You'll work closely with our People Business Partners, our Associate People Business Partner, and an L&D coordinator who supports the learning platform and content production. Together you will ramp front-line managers faster, equip the People team with the playbooks and training it needs, and make learning part of how the business runs. This role moves beyond administrative operations to focus on strategic partnership and the integration of AI to empower our people.

 On a day-to-day basis, you will:

• Own program lifecycles. Oversee end-to-end program lifecycles, including planning, development, delivery, and assessment.

• Create and lead workshops. Design and facilitate creative, robust enablement workshops and learning solutions for employees at all levels.

• Partner with People Business Partners. Work directly with People Business Partners to identify and align on specific talent gaps, and build solutions that fit what each business needs.

• Ramp front-line managers. Build and run manager and leadership programs, working with the PBPs, so new and developing managers can coach, handle performance conversations, and lead with confidence.

• Own onboarding and new-hire enablement. Create a consistent, practical onboarding experience that gets new employees productive faster.

• Enable the People team. Build playbooks, training and job aids for PBPs and Shared Services on topics such as calibration, employee relations and change management.

• Shape the learning architecture. Help architect a system of learning that is cohesive and provides a seamless journey for employees at all levels.

• Innovate with AI. Experiment with and implement AI-powered tools to automate workflows, personalize curriculum creation, and continuously invest in AI for workforce enablement.

• Drive business execution. Develop tailored strategies to address performance gaps, with clear objectives, development plans, and accountability measures, and make sure all programming aligns with near-term and long-term goals.

• Run the learning platform. Own the LMS and content library, working with the L&D coordinator on administration, scheduling and production.

• Analyze and interpret. Use data to identify trends, monitor program completions and impact, and provide actionable insights that inform future learning strategy.

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:

 We are seeking a strategic, results-driven partner who moves beyond operations to become a true consultant to the business. You are someone who understands how individual success drives company-wide goals and can build robust learning solutions that reflect the pragmatic needs of a fast-growing organization. You are comfortable embedding with the business and the People team. You build as well as plan: you ship programs, not just roadmaps, and you are equally at home designing a strategy and running the session. You care about proving that what you build works.

 THE SKILL SET:

• 5+ years of combined experience in learning and development, enablement, organizational development, HR, or a related field, ideally in a technology-driven environment.

• Workshop facilitation: Proven ability to lead engaging enablement workshops across a variety of formats (live, in-person, or remote).

• Manager and onboarding programs: Experience designing and delivering manager development and onboarding programs.

• Instructional innovation: Proven ability to experiment with emerging learning technologies, creative modalities, and unconventional approaches that push beyond traditional training while applying adult learning principles.

• Strategic partnership: Skilled at building trust and credibility with senior leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.

• AI and technical aptitude: Experience leveraging AI to automate workflows, analyze insights, or create curriculum; aptitude for maintaining learning technology systems.

• Systems thinking: Strong business acumen to understand how learning initiatives impact the broader organization and culture.

• Program ownership: Strong project management skills with a demonstrated ability to work independently to see a program from concept to delivery.

• Hands-on execution: A track record of shipping programs and learning assets on a deadline, from design through delivery.

• Communication and influence: Effective communication skills to present findings and influence diverse audiences across many company levels.

• Instructional design: Strong foundation in instructional design methodologies and frameworks, with experience developing structured curriculum and learning objectives across diverse subject matters.

• Measurement: Experience measuring program impact and reporting results to leaders.

title: Senior Integration Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Mexico

 Senior Integration Engineer

 Remote, Mexico

 JOB OVERVIEW

 Are you passionate about building large-scale applications leveraging public cloud services and integration design patterns? As an Integration Engineer, you will work on developing and maintaining Integration & Automation Solutions for Legion WFM customers.

 RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

 Integration Engineers provide leadership, facilitate analysis and design tasks, and support multiple Legion teams in developing an enterprise's solution architecture. Job responsibilities are grouped across four key areas: Technical Integrations, Customer-Centric Consulting, Legion Product Expertise, and a Commitment to One Another.

 Please note this role involves participation in on-call rotation.

 Technical Integrations

• Design and implement scalable integration architectures connecting Legion with HR, POS, Payroll, and other enterprise systems.

• Design, Build, and Test integrations using Workato

• Develop secure and efficient REST APIs within Legion's API-driven ecosystem.

• Ensure high-performance, reliable integrations using modern cloud platforms.

• Engage with architects and engineers for design collaboration and code reviews.

• Improve development practices and stay ahead of agile software engineering trends.

 Legion Product Expertise

• Gain and maintain deep knowledge of Legion's product and integration ecosystem.

• Identify, report, and prioritize product bugs and enhancements.

• Work with core engineering and production engineering teams to improve backend reliability and troubleshoot production issues

• Stay updated on new releases and enhancements to drive product adoption.

• Write secure, enterprise-grade integration code using leading platforms and technologies.

• Write well-designed, testable, efficient code

• Contribute to all phases of the development lifecycle

• Conduct peer code reviews to ensure code quality and maintainability.

 Team Collaboration & Mentorship

• Share expertise and mentor junior engineers, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing.

• Contribute to best practices for integration and internal technical documentation.

• Support process improvements and advocate for scalable, sustainable integrations.

• Commit to high-quality work, setting personal and team objectives aligned with organizational goals.

• Standard shift working hours: 0900-1800

• This role involves participation in on-call rotation.

• This role may require work outside of normal business hours.

 REQUIRED SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 7+ years of business/information/solution/technical architecture experience

• Graduate of a university with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant STEM field, including Information Systems, Engineering, Computer Science, or another relevant degree

• Must be able to work as a team player, yet can work independently.

• Analytical, results-driven, and have a solution-oriented approach

• Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills, including verbal, written presentation, and listening.

• 3+ years of experience with event-driven Architecture and Microservices

• Demonstrated deep technical expertise in Integration technologies and protocols such as HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, SOAP, REST, JMS, JDBC

• Experience using Linux/Unix environments

• Demonstrate proficiency with Core Java.

• Experience with Relational Databases, SQL and JDBC (one of Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, etc.)

• 2+ years of experience using AWS technologies such as AWS CDK, Cloud formation, S3, ECS, EKS, and EC2

• Demonstrate experience with test-driven development.

• Strong experience with Java/RESTful web services

• Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)

• Demonstrate knowledge and experience with CI/CD processes and tools.

• Proven track record of using problem-solving / root-cause analysis

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS AND ATTRIBUTES

• The ideal candidate has workforce management integration experience

• Preferred experience in the design and implementation of scalable integration solutions with integration platforms such as Workato, SAP BTP Integration Suite, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit, SnapLogic

• Proactive and able to command respect through intelligence, hard work, and persistence

• Technical consulting experience.

• Experience of working with Docker and other isolation technologies.

• Experience working with external applications integrations end-to-end such as Workday, SAP, etc.

 COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 At Legion, we offer competitive compensation and benefits packages to all employees. As a fully remote employer, pay for positions is determined using local, national, and industry-specific survey data.

 We strive to make competitive offers allowing employees room for future growth. Salaries will be based on the applicant’s location, level of experience, education, and specialized knowledge and skills. Additionally, we consider the external market rate, the amount we have budgeted internally, and internal equity within the company for the same position.

 Benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Health Benefits

• Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays

• Parental Leave

• Equity

• Monthly Wellness Reimbursement

• Monthly Lunch on Legion

 ABOUT LEGION

 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a remote, mission-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission. Legion Technologies delivers the industry’s most innovative workforce management platform. It enables businesses to maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously. The award-winning, AI-driven Legion WFM platform is intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. It’s proven to deliver 13x ROI through schedule optimization, reduced attrition, increased productivity, and increased operational efficiency. Legion delivers cutting-edge technology in an easy-to-use platform and mobile app that employees love.

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.

 BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY

 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously. Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is comprised of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.

 For more information, visit https://legion.co

 As a global employer, Legion determines pay for positions using local, national, and industry-specific survey data. We evaluate external equity and the cost of labor/prevailing wage index in the relative marketplace for jobs directly comparable to jobs within our company. Our posted salary range is based on national data and may be refined for a candidate's region/town/cost of living. The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
description:
The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale.
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections.
For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/

title: Research Scientist - Generative Audio
description:
We are seeking Research Scientists (across all levels of seniority) to join our Artist-First AI Music Lab. Our team pioneers and advances state-of-the-art generative technologies for music that create breakthrough experiences for fans and artists. We invent entirely new listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles:
Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We’ll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later.
Choice in participation: We recognize there’s a wide range of views on the use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music.
Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for the use of their work and transparently credited for their contributions.
Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship - France
description:
A World-Changing Company 
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.
 
The Role
 
Palantir has long been a landing spot for top Grandes Écoles engineering students and graduates. In this spirit, we are excited to launch a 12-month fellowship in New York City for students and recent graduates of the Grandes Écoles. Fellows will join alongside full-time Palantirians, supplemented with programming curated to fuel growth and criticality. Fellowships will begin October 2026. Candidates can participate in the fellowship during Grandes Écoles’ gap year, as a 3rd year internship, or within 12-months of graduation.
 
Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) work directly with customers to quickly understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions to use data against them. Our customers rely on Palantir’s platforms for some of their most critical operations, and projects often start with an open ended question like "How do we evaluate wildfire risk and optimize a power grid as a result" or "How do we quickly assess our food supply chain and modify it to deliver life saving assistance on time?" As an FDSE, you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
This role is based in our New York City office and is open to students and recent graduates of the French Grandes Écoles.
 
Core Responsibilities

You'll build the foundational capabilities that power our products used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world.

Frontline
 
Foundry Software Engineers may be offered the opportunity to Frontline, an exclusive program unlike any other. This unique, short-term assignment involves being embedded with customers, allowing you to work directly with users and gain firsthand insight into how our products are used and the challenges our customers face. Unlike traditional engineering roles, Frontline immerses you in complex, ambiguous problems, empowering you to deliver impactful solutions across some of the world’s most important industries and institutions.
 
Some of our most successful products were built on the factory floor, addressing real-world problems for the world's most important institutions. These products were developed by some of our most successful product engineers, who began their careers in roles aligned with Frontline responsibilities, gaining a deep understanding of both our technology and our customers.
 
Frontliners operate across a broad spectrum of responsibilities, much like a startup CTO. They work in small teams to own the end-to-end execution of high-stakes projects. This spectrum ranges from discussing architecture and building custom web apps to conducting workshops with users and strategizing with customer executives. No two days are alike, as each day is diverse and impactful.  As a New Grad, you will be entrusted with responsibility on day 1. You will not be handed a ticket queue. You will not be shielded from the customer, the chaos, or the consequences.
